r001.tagline_en: A quiet room, and a scent to keep you company.
r001.benefit_zh: 独处时容易想太多、心里空落落的，这瓶清亮的柑橘香帮你把注意力拉回当下，让一个人的时间变得自在。
r001.benefit_en: When time alone turns into overthinking, this bright citrus brings your attention back to the moment and makes solitude feel easy.
r001.scene_zh: 在家看书、整理房间或者夜里一个人加班时，涂在颈侧，或者滴进香薰机，让空间亮一点。
r001.scene_en: Reading at home, tidying up or working late alone: dab it on the sides of the neck or put a few drops in the diffuser.
r001.action_zh: 莱姆清爽提神，佛手柑在柑橘里带一点花香和温柔，两者等量搭配，明亮但不刺激。
r001.action_en: Lime is crisp and clearing; bergamot adds a gentle floral warmth. Equal parts keep it bright without being sharp.
r001.scent_zh: 像刚切开的青柠，混着一点茶香和花香。
r001.scent_en: Like a freshly cut lime with a hint of tea and flowers.

r002.tagline_zh: 给心里那团火一点凉意。
r002.tagline_en: A little cool air for a short fuse.
r002.benefit_zh: 一点小事就想发脾气、心浮气躁的日子，用它慢慢深呼吸，让情绪先降温，再好好说话。
r002.benefit_en: On days when small things set you off, breathe this in slowly and let your mood cool before you speak.
r002.scene_zh: 开会前、接孩子前、和家人沟通前，涂在后背或手心，闻三次再开口。
r002.scene_en: Before a meeting, the school run or a hard conversation: rub it on your back or palms and take three breaths first.
r002.action_zh: 天竺葵让心情回到平衡，佛手柑带来轻快，西伯利亚冷杉的森林气息让人沉下来。
r002.action_en: Geranium brings balance, bergamot lightness, and Siberian fir a forest calm that settles you.
r002.scent_zh: 玫瑰般的绿叶花香，后面是清冷的松林。
r002.scent_en: Rosy green florals giving way to cool pine forest.

r003.tagline_zh: 脑子里那层雾，慢慢散了。
r003.tagline_en: Watch the haze in your head clear.
r003.benefit_zh: 早上醒不来、下午脑子发闷、想事情转不动的时候，用一点清凉草本让头脑清楚起来。
r003.benefit_en: For slow mornings, foggy afternoons and thoughts that won't move, a cool herbal lift to clear your head.
r003.scene_zh: 出门上班前、准备考试或写报告时，涂在头部，或者涂在手心捂住口鼻深呼吸。
r003.scene_en: Before work, exams or writing: apply to the head, or cup your palms over your nose and breathe deeply.
r003.action_zh: 迷迭香清醒，椒样薄荷清凉，绿薄荷把整体变得柔和香甜，清醒又不冲。
r003.action_en: Rosemary wakes, peppermint cools and spearmint softens it all, so it's clear but never harsh.
r003.scent_zh: 清晨的香草园，带着凉凉的薄荷叶。
r003.scent_en: An herb garden at dawn, with cool mint leaves.

r004.tagline_zh: 压力大的时候，先让自己喘口气。
r004.benefit_zh: 事情一件接一件、心里绷得紧的时候，这瓶柑橘木香帮你松一松，找回节奏。
r004.benefit_en: When tasks pile up and you feel wound tight, this citrus-and-wood blend helps you loosen up and find your pace.
r004.scene_zh: 下班回家进门前、睡前洗完澡，涂在后背或手心嗅吸，给自己五分钟。
r004.scene_en: Before you walk in the door after work or after an evening shower: back or palms, and give yourself five minutes.
r004.action_zh: 红橘甜美安抚，佛手柑轻盈明亮，枫香带一点树脂的沉稳，让香气有落脚点。
r004.action_en: Red mandarin soothes, bergamot lightens and liquidambar's resin gives the scent somewhere to land.
r004.scent_zh: 橘子皮的甜，接着是温暖的树脂香。
r004.scent_en: Sweet mandarin peel followed by warm resin.

r005.tagline_zh: 没精神的日子，给自己一点光。
r005.tagline_en: A little light for low-energy days.
r005.benefit_zh: 提不起劲、心情灰灰的时候，用它把精神提起来，同时保持踏实，不会飘。
r005.benefit_en: When you can't get going and the mood is grey, it lifts your spirits while keeping you grounded.
r005.scene_zh: 早上起床后、午饭后犯困时，涂在头部或手心嗅吸，一天三次。
r005.scene_en: After waking or the after-lunch slump: head or palms, up to three times a day.
r005.action_zh: 佛手柑负责明亮，古巴香脂和乳香负责稳住，让好心情维持得久一些。
r005.action_en: Bergamot brings the brightness; copaiba and frankincense hold it steady so the good mood lasts.
r005.scent_zh: 阳光下的柑橘，衬着温暖的木头和树脂。
r005.scent_en: Sunlit citrus over warm wood and resin.

r006.tagline_zh: 像坐在树林里做事，专心又安静。
r006.tagline_en: Work as if you were sitting among the trees.
r006.benefit_zh: 一坐下就分心、事情做不完的时候，这瓶森林木香帮你稳住心神，专注在眼前这件事。
r006.benefit_en: When you sit down and drift off task, this woodland blend steadies you and keeps you on the one thing in front of you.
r006.scene_zh: 开始工作或学习前，涂在手心嗅吸，再轻抹太阳穴，一天三次。
r006.scene_en: Before work or study: breathe it from your palms and touch it to your temples, up to three times a day.
r006.action_zh: 道格拉斯冷杉和黑云杉清新透气，岩兰草的根部香气沉稳，把飘走的心拉回来。
r006.action_en: Douglas fir and black spruce open the air; vetiver's deep root note pulls a wandering mind back.
r006.scent_zh: 松针、冷空气，和一点潮湿的泥土。
r006.scent_en: Pine needles, cold air and a touch of damp earth.

r007.tagline_en: For a lower belly that feels fresh and light.
r007.benefit_zh: 久坐、下腹闷闷沉沉的时候，用这瓶清爽的柑橘草香做日常按摩，让下腹轻松一些。
r007.benefit_en: After long sitting, when your lower belly feels heavy, use this fresh citrus-grass blend as a daily massage.
r007.scene_zh: 早晚洗澡后，取适量在小腹顺时针轻揉几分钟。
r007.scene_en: After your morning and evening shower, massage a little into the lower belly in slow clockwise circles.
r007.action_zh: 莱姆和柠檬草清新净爽，加州胡椒带一点温热，让按摩时有暖意。
r007.action_en: Lime and lemongrass keep it clean and fresh; pink pepper adds warmth to the massage.
r007.scent_zh: 青柠和柠檬草的清香，尾韵有淡淡的胡椒。
r007.scent_en: Lime and lemongrass with a soft peppery finish.

r008.title_en: A Warm Current at the Waist
r008.tagline_en: Care for the lower belly and back together.
r008.benefit_zh: 下腹和后腰常常一起觉得沉、觉得凉的人，用它做早晚按摩，让腰腹舒畅温暖。
r008.benefit_en: If your lower belly and back often feel heavy or cold together, massage with this morning and night for warmth and ease.
r008.scene_zh: 早晚涂抹小腹和后腰，搓热双手再按，效果更舒服。
r008.scene_en: Apply to the lower belly and back morning and night; warm your hands first.
r008.action_zh: 杜松浆果清爽净化，雪松稳重温和，罗勒带草本的暖意，一起让腰腹放松。
r008.action_en: Juniper berry is clean and fresh, cedarwood steady, basil herbaceous and warm; together they relax the core.
r008.scent_zh: 木质和浆果香，带着罗勒叶的辛甜。
r008.scent_en: Wood and berries with the sweet spice of basil leaf.

r009.tagline_zh: 给怕冷的下腹一点温度。
r009.tagline_en: Warmth for a belly that feels the cold.
r009.benefit_zh: 手脚凉、下腹也常常凉凉的人，这瓶温润的木香让腰腹被暖暖包住。
r009.benefit_en: For people whose hands, feet and belly often run cold, this mellow wood blend wraps the core in warmth.
r009.scene_zh: 天气转凉或晚上睡前，涂抹小腹和后腰，再盖上一条毯子。
r009.scene_en: When the weather turns or before bed, apply to the lower belly and back, then pull a blanket over.
r009.action_zh: 檀香温润安定，没药沉稳，柠檬草少量点亮，让暖意不闷。
r009.action_en: Sandalwood is warm and settling, myrrh deep, and a little lemongrass keeps it from feeling heavy.
r009.scent_zh: 檀木和树脂的暖香，透一点青草气。
r009.scent_en: Warm sandalwood and resin with a breath of green grass.

r010.tagline_zh: 腹部和下背的一圈温柔按摩。
r010.tagline_en: A gentle circle of massage around your core.
r010.benefit_zh: 久坐、下背和下腹容易僵、容易凉，用它按摩让身体中段放松、回暖。
r010.benefit_en: When sitting leaves your lower back and belly stiff or cold, this massage relaxes and rewarms your middle.
r010.scene_zh: 早晚取适量，从下腹绕到下背轻轻按揉。
r010.scene_en: Morning and night, massage gently from the lower belly round to the lower back.
r010.action_zh: 丝柏让人觉得轻快，生姜温暖，苦橙叶带来放松的花叶香。
r010.action_en: Cypress feels light and moving, ginger warm, and petitgrain adds a relaxing leafy floral.
r010.scent_zh: 雨后的松林，混着姜和橙叶。
r010.scent_en: A rain-washed forest with ginger and orange leaf.

r011.tagline_en: Fresh lemon care for the waist.
r011.benefit_zh: 饮食不规律、腰腹觉得胀胀重重的时候，用这瓶柠香按摩，让腰腹清爽轻盈。
r011.benefit_en: When irregular meals leave your waist feeling full and heavy, massage with this lemony blend for a lighter feel.
r011.scene_zh: 早晚涂抹小腹和后腰，顺时针按摩。
r011.scene_en: Morning and night, apply to the lower belly and back and massage clockwise.
r011.action_zh: 柠檬清新明亮，芫荽籽和小茴香是厨房里常见的暖胃香料，按摩时舒服又安心。
r011.action_en: Lemon is bright and clean; coriander seed and fennel are kitchen spices that feel comforting in a massage.
r011.scent_zh: 柠檬皮的清香，带甜甜的茴香籽。
r011.scent_en: Lemon zest with sweet fennel seed.

r012.tagline_en: Let your scalp take a deep breath.
r012.benefit_zh: 头皮紧绷、头发看起来没精神时，这瓶木质草本按摩油让头皮放松、清爽。
r012.benefit_en: When your scalp feels tight and your hair looks tired, this wood-and-herb oil relaxes and refreshes the scalp.
r012.scene_zh: 洗头前或睡前，用指腹蘸取按摩头皮几分钟。
r012.scene_en: Before washing or at bedtime, massage into the scalp with your fingertips for a few minutes.
r012.action_zh: 迷迭香和雪松是护发常用的组合，生姜带来温热感，薰衣草让按摩时更放松。
r012.action_en: Rosemary and cedarwood are a classic hair pairing; ginger adds warmth and lavender makes it more relaxing.
r012.scent_zh: 雪松木香打底，迷迭香和薰衣草在上面。
r012.scent_en: Cedarwood underneath, rosemary and lavender on top.

r013.tagline_zh: 让头发看起来更有生气。
r013.tagline_en: For hair that looks more alive.
r013.benefit_zh: 想让头发看起来更丰盈、头皮更健康，可以把它当成日常头皮保养。
r013.benefit_en: For fuller-looking hair and a healthier-feeling scalp, use it as part of your daily scalp care.
r013.scene_zh: 早晚分开头发，点涂在头皮上，用指腹轻轻按开。
r013.scene_en: Morning and night, part your hair, dot it on the scalp and work it in with your fingertips.
r013.action_zh: 雪松稳重，薰衣草温和，百里香带来清爽的草本感。
r013.action_en: Cedarwood is steady, lavender gentle, and thyme brings a fresh herbal edge.
r013.scent_zh: 木香里有薰衣草的花香和一点百里香。
r013.scent_en: Wood with lavender florals and a touch of thyme.

r014.tagline_en: A fresh scalp and softer hair.
r014.benefit_zh: 头皮容易闷、头发干涩时，用它少量多次照顾，让头皮清爽、头发顺一点。
r014.benefit_en: When the scalp feels stuffy and hair feels dry, a little often keeps the scalp fresh and the hair smoother.
r014.scene_zh: 洗发后头发半干时，取一点在头皮和发尾抹开。
r014.scene_en: When your hair is half-dry after washing, work a little into the scalp and ends.
r014.action_zh: 茶树清洁感强，雪松护发，柠檬草让整体清新。
r014.action_en: Tea tree feels cleansing, cedarwood cares for hair and lemongrass freshens the whole blend.
r014.scent_zh: 清新草本和木质，像洗过的森林。
r014.scent_en: Fresh herbs and wood, like a forest after rain.

r015.tagline_zh: 头皮出油的人可以试试。
r015.benefit_zh: 头皮容易出油、到下午就塌的人，用它做早晚头皮护理，让头皮维持清爽。
r015.benefit_en: If your scalp gets oily and your hair falls flat by afternoon, use it morning and night to keep the scalp fresh.
r015.scene_zh: 早晚点涂在头皮出油最多的地方，按摩一分钟。
r015.scene_en: Morning and night, dot it where your scalp gets oiliest and massage for a minute.
r015.action_zh: 雪松让头皮平衡，苦橙叶清淡，岩兰草带来沉稳的根部香气。
r015.action_en: Cedarwood helps balance, petitgrain is light and vetiver adds a deep root note.
r015.scent_zh: 干净的木香，带一点橙叶和泥土。
r015.scent_en: Clean wood with orange leaf and earth.

r016.tagline_zh: 像雨后空气一样清爽的头皮。
r016.tagline_en: A scalp as fresh as the air after rain.
r016.benefit_zh: 头皮闷热、容易痒的季节，用它做清爽护理，让头皮舒服透气。
r016.benefit_en: In seasons when your scalp feels hot and itchy, use it for a fresh, breathable feel.
r016.scene_zh: 早晚涂抹头皮，运动出汗后也可以用。
r016.scene_en: Apply to the scalp morning and night, or after a sweaty workout.
r016.action_zh: 茶树清洁，丝柏清爽，百里香带一点草本的锐利感。
r016.action_en: Tea tree cleanses, cypress freshens and thyme adds a sharp herbal note.
r016.scent_zh: 草本、木质，带一点药草的清凉。
r016.scent_en: Herbal and woody, with a cool medicinal edge.

r017.tagline_zh: 让头发看起来更有光泽。
r017.benefit_zh: 头发看起来干、没有光泽的时候，用它少量多次照顾头皮和发丝。
r017.benefit_en: When hair looks dull and dry, care for the scalp and lengths with a little, often.
r017.scene_zh: 每天取少量，梳头时带到发丝上，再按摩头皮。
r017.scene_en: Each day, take a little onto your brush, then massage the scalp.
r017.action_zh: 迷迭香和雪松照顾头皮，薰衣草让香气柔和。
r017.action_en: Rosemary and cedarwood care for the scalp; lavender softens the scent.
r017.scent_zh: 迷迭香的草本香，薰衣草花香收尾。

r018.tagline_zh: 那几天，给小腹一点温柔。
r018.tagline_en: A little tenderness for those days.
r018.benefit_zh: 经期前后小腹不舒服、心情也跟着低落时，用甜甜的茴香轻轻按摩，舒缓又安心。
r018.benefit_en: Around your period, when your belly and mood both dip, a gentle massage with sweet fennel feels soothing and safe.
r018.scene_zh: 早晚躺下，取适量在小腹顺时针轻揉，配一个暖水袋更舒服。
r018.scene_en: Lie down morning and night and massage your belly clockwise; a hot water bottle helps.
r018.action_zh: 甜茴香带有天然的甘甜温暖，是腹部按摩很常用的单方。
r018.action_en: Sweet fennel has a natural sweet warmth and is a classic single oil for belly massage.
r018.scent_zh: 像甘草和蜂蜜，甜而温暖。
r018.scent_en: Like liquorice and honey, sweet and warm.

r019.tagline_zh: 随着周期，温和地照顾自己。
r019.tagline_en: Gentle care that moves with your cycle.
r019.benefit_zh: 经期小腹和下背沉重、容易累，用它温和地按摩，让身体轻松一些。
r019.benefit_en: When your period leaves your belly and lower back heavy and tired, a gentle massage brings ease.
r019.scene_zh: 经期前几天开始，每天三次涂抹小腹和下背。
r019.scene_en: From a few days before your period, apply to the belly and lower back three times a day.
r019.action_zh: 丝柏带来轻快感，芹菜籽温和，永久花让皮肤舒服。
r019.action_en: Cypress feels light, celery seed gentle, and helichrysum kind to the skin.
r019.scent_zh: 清新木香，带一点蜜香和草本。

r020.tagline_zh: 像有人用暖手帮你揉肚子。
r020.tagline_en: Like warm hands rubbing your belly.
r020.benefit_zh: 经期小腹发凉、闷闷不舒服时，用它按摩让腹部暖和、放松。
r020.benefit_en: When your belly feels cold and uncomfortable during your period, massage for warmth and relaxation.
r020.scene_zh: 一天三次，涂抹小腹和下背，按完盖好衣服保暖。
r020.scene_en: Three times a day on the belly and lower back, then keep covered and warm.
r020.action_zh: 罗勒和小茴香温暖，椒样薄荷先凉后暖，让按摩更有感觉。
r020.action_en: Basil and fennel warm; peppermint cools then warms, so you really feel the massage.
r020.scent_zh: 罗勒叶、茴香籽，一点清凉薄荷。
r020.scent_en: Basil leaf, fennel seed and a cool hint of mint.

r021.tagline_zh: 让每个月都过得平稳一些。
r021.tagline_en: For months that run a little smoother.
r021.benefit_zh: 周期前后情绪起伏、小腹不适的女性，用三种花香按摩，帮身心找回平衡。
r021.benefit_en: For women whose mood and belly swing around their cycle, three florals in a massage help restore balance.
r021.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹小腹和下背。备孕期和孕期请勿使用。
r021.scene_en: Three times a day on the belly and lower back. Not for use when trying to conceive or pregnant.
r021.action_zh: 快乐鼠尾草是女性周期最常用的单方，天竺葵平衡，薰衣草让人放松。
r021.action_en: Clary sage is the go-to for the female cycle, geranium balances and lavender relaxes.
r021.scent_zh: 草本花香，像傍晚的花园。
r021.scent_en: Herbal florals, like a garden at dusk.

r022.tagline_en: One oil to warm the belly.
r022.benefit_zh: 想简单一点照顾经期小腹，用快乐鼠尾草单方按摩，舒缓又放松。
r022.benefit_en: For simple period care, a single-oil massage with clary sage soothes and relaxes.
r022.scene_zh: 早晚轻轻按摩小腹，按完喝一杯温水。
r022.scene_en: Massage the belly gently morning and night, then sip some warm water.
r022.action_zh: 快乐鼠尾草的草本花香让人放松，特别适合每月那几天的腹部按摩。
r022.action_en: Clary sage's herbal floral is deeply relaxing and made for belly massage during those days.
r022.scent_zh: 带泥土气的草本花香，像晒过太阳的鼠尾草。
r022.scent_en: Earthy herbal floral, like sun-warmed sage.

r023.tagline_en: A grounding scent that settles the belly.
r023.benefit_zh: 小腹常常不舒服、心里也不安定的时候，用这瓶沉稳的木质香按摩，让人踏实下来。
r023.benefit_en: When your belly is uneasy and so is your mind, this deep woody blend helps you feel grounded.
r023.scene_zh: 早晚涂抹小腹，按摩时慢慢深呼吸。
r023.scene_en: Morning and night on the belly, breathing slowly as you massage.
r023.action_zh: 乳香和没药是古老的树脂组合，岩兰草的根部香气让人安定。
r023.action_en: Frankincense and myrrh are an ancient resin pairing; vetiver's root note brings calm.
r023.scent_zh: 树脂、泥土和一点烟熏木香。
r023.scent_en: Resin, earth and a touch of smoky wood.

r024.benefit_zh: 胸部常觉得紧绷、不舒展时，用这瓶温暖辛香轻柔按摩，让胸口放松。
r024.benefit_en: When your chest often feels tight, a gentle massage with this warm spice helps it relax.
r024.scene_zh: 早晚洗澡后轻柔按摩胸部，避开乳头。
r024.scene_en: After your morning and evening shower, massage the chest gently, avoiding the nipples.
r024.action_zh: 丁香温暖，檀香和没药温润滋养，让按摩舒适而不刺激。
r024.action_en: Clove warms, while sandalwood and myrrh nourish, keeping the massage comfortable.
r024.scent_zh: 丁香的辛香，裹在檀木里。

r025.tagline_en: Light, fresh care for the chest.
r025.benefit_zh: 想要日常轻柔地照顾胸部，这瓶带柑橘香的配方温和清新。
r025.benefit_en: For gentle daily chest care, this citrus-led blend is soft and fresh.
r025.scene_zh: 早晚涂抹并由外向内轻轻打圈，避开乳头。
r025.scene_en: Morning and night, massage in gentle circles from the outside in, avoiding the nipples.
r025.action_zh: 野橘明亮，丝柏带来轻快感，古巴香脂温和滋润。
r025.action_en: Wild orange is bright, cypress light and copaiba gently nourishing.
r025.scent_zh: 甜橙香，衬着淡淡的木香。
r025.scent_en: Sweet orange over a soft wood note.

r026.benefit_zh: 想让胸部按摩成为放松的仪式，这瓶花香草本配方让过程更愉悦。
r026.benefit_en: To make chest massage a relaxing ritual, this floral-herbal blend makes it a pleasure.
r026.scene_zh: 早晚洗澡后按摩胸部，注意避开乳头。
r026.scene_en: After showering morning and night, massage the chest, avoiding the nipples.
r026.action_zh: 甜茴香温暖，快乐鼠尾草和薰衣草让人放松，适合女性的日常护理。
r026.action_en: Sweet fennel warms, and clary sage and lavender relax; made for women's daily care.
r026.scent_zh: 甜茴香和薰衣草，温柔的花草香。
r026.scent_en: Sweet fennel and lavender, soft and herbal.

r027.tagline_zh: 温和照顾私密处周围的肌肤。
r027.benefit_zh: 私密处周围肌肤需要温和、安心的照顾，这瓶沉稳的配方让人放心。
r027.benefit_en: Intimate skin needs gentle, reassuring care, and this grounded blend provides it.
r027.scene_zh: 早晚洗澡后，涂抹在私处周围的外部肌肤。
r027.scene_en: After showering morning and night, apply to the outer skin around the intimate area only.
r027.action_zh: 乳香温和，岩兰草沉稳，生姜带一点温暖。
r027.action_en: Frankincense is gentle, vetiver grounding and ginger adds warmth.
r027.scent_zh: 温暖的树脂和根部香气。

r028.tagline_zh: 暖暖的香料，暖暖的肚子。
r028.tagline_en: Warm spices for a warm belly.
r028.benefit_zh: 小腹容易发凉、喜欢喝热饮的人，用这瓶香料按摩油让腹部温暖起来。
r028.benefit_en: If your belly runs cold and you reach for hot drinks, this spice massage warms you through.
r028.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹小腹和下背，冬天特别适合。
r028.scene_en: Three times a day on the belly and lower back, especially in winter.
r028.action_zh: 芫荽籽和小茴香是暖胃香料，生姜让暖意更明显。
r028.action_en: Coriander seed and fennel are warming kitchen spices; ginger makes the warmth stronger.
r028.scent_zh: 像一壶煮着香料的热茶。
r028.scent_en: Like a pot of spiced tea on the stove.

r029.tagline_en: A light massage for the lower belly.
r029.benefit_zh: 想要清爽、不黏腻的下腹按摩，这瓶柑橘木香轻柔又舒服。
r029.benefit_en: For a light, non-greasy belly massage, this citrus-and-wood blend is soft and comfortable.
r029.scene_zh: 早晚轻轻按摩小腹。喜欢甜一点的香气，野橘可以加到 10 滴。
r029.scene_en: Massage gently morning and night. Like it sweeter? Go up to 10 drops of wild orange.
r029.action_zh: 丝柏是主角，带来轻快感，野橘和乳香让香气甜美稳定。
r029.action_en: Cypress leads with lightness; wild orange and frankincense make it sweet and steady.

r030.tagline_en: Relax the belly and back together.
r030.benefit_zh: 下腹和腰背常常一起累的人，用它按摩一圈，让身体中段松下来。
r030.benefit_en: When your belly and back tire together, massage all the way round to let your middle relax.
r030.scene_zh: 早晚从下腹绕到下背，慢慢按揉。
r030.scene_en: Morning and night, massage slowly from the belly round to the lower back.
r030.action_zh: 丝柏轻快，甜茴香温暖，岩兰草沉稳。
r030.action_en: Cypress lightens, sweet fennel warms and vetiver grounds.

r031.tagline_en: Fresh daily care for women in their later years.
r031.benefit_zh: 年纪渐长，下腹觉得干涩不清爽的时候，用没药做温和的日常按摩。
r031.benefit_en: As the years go on and the lower belly feels less fresh, myrrh makes a gentle daily massage.
r031.scene_zh: 和基底油混合均匀后，早晚轻柔按摩小腹。
r031.scene_en: Mix well with carrier oil and massage the lower belly gently morning and night.
r031.action_zh: 没药滋润温和，自古就是照顾肌肤的树脂。
r031.action_en: Myrrh is nourishing and gentle, a resin used for skin since ancient times.
r031.scent_zh: 微苦的树脂香，带一点烟熏。
r031.scent_en: A slightly bitter resin with a hint of smoke.

r032.tagline_en: For nights you wake up warm.
r032.benefit_zh: 熟龄女性夜里容易燥热、睡不安稳，用丝柏轻柔按摩，让夜晚舒服一些。
r032.benefit_en: For women who wake up hot and restless at night, a gentle cypress massage makes nights more comfortable.
r032.scene_zh: 早晚涂抹小腹并轻轻按摩，睡前那次最重要。
r032.scene_en: Massage the lower belly morning and night; the bedtime one matters most.
r032.action_zh: 丝柏清爽带凉意，让人觉得轻盈、透气。
r032.action_en: Cypress is cool and fresh, leaving you feeling light and airy.

r033.tagline_en: Taking good care through the change.
r033.benefit_zh: 更年期身体忽冷忽热、心情也起伏，用这瓶清凉草本按摩下腹和下背，帮自己稳一稳。
r033.benefit_en: When menopause brings hot-and-cold swings and moods, massage the belly and back with this cool herb blend to steady yourself.
r033.scene_zh: 早晚涂抹下腹和下背，轻轻按摩。
r033.scene_en: Morning and night, massage the lower belly and back.
r033.action_zh: 快乐鼠尾草照顾女性，罗勒温暖，椒样薄荷带来清凉。
r033.action_en: Clary sage is there for women, basil warms and peppermint cools.
r033.scent_zh: 罗勒、薄荷和鼠尾草，清新草本。
r033.scent_en: Basil, mint and sage: fresh and herbal.

r034.tagline_zh: 产后的心，需要被温柔对待。
r034.tagline_en: A new mother's heart deserves tenderness.
r034.benefit_zh: 产后作息被打乱、情绪容易低落，用这组温柔的香气扩香，让家里的空气暖一些。
r034.benefit_en: When a new baby turns your days upside down and your mood dips, diffuse this soft trio to warm the air at home.
r034.scene_zh: 按顺序和比例滴 4–6 滴到香薰机，白天或喂奶时扩香。
r034.scene_en: Add 4–6 drops in the given order and ratio to the diffuser, during the day or while feeding.
r034.action_zh: 依兰花香让人放松，乳香安定，快乐鼠尾草温柔支持女性。
r034.action_en: Ylang ylang relaxes, frankincense steadies and clary sage gently supports women.
r034.scent_zh: 浓郁的花香，底下是树脂和草本。
r034.scent_en: Rich florals over resin and herbs.

r036.tagline_en: For when you need a breath during pregnancy.
r036.benefit_zh: 孕期闻到某些味道就不舒服，一滴生姜在手心嗅吸，让呼吸清爽一些。
r036.benefit_en: When certain smells unsettle you during pregnancy, a single drop of ginger in your palms freshens your breath.
r036.scene_zh: 取 1 滴在手心，搓热后捂住口鼻慢慢嗅吸。使用前请先咨询医生。
r036.scene_en: Put one drop in your palms, rub them warm and breathe slowly. Check with your doctor first.
r036.action_zh: 生姜的辛暖香气简单直接，只用一滴就够。
r036.action_en: Ginger's warm spice is simple and direct; one drop is enough.

r037.tagline_zh: 给男士私密肌肤的日常照顾。
r037.tagline_en: Daily care for men's intimate skin.
r037.benefit_zh: 男士私密部位附近的肌肤也需要清爽照顾，这瓶草本花香让人干净舒服。
r037.benefit_en: Men's intimate skin needs fresh care too; this herbal floral keeps it clean and comfortable.
r037.scene_zh: 早晚洗澡后，涂抹于私密部位附近的肌肤。
r037.scene_en: After showering morning and night, apply to the skin around the intimate area.
r037.action_zh: 天竺葵平衡，薰衣草温和，迷迭香清爽。
r037.action_en: Geranium balances, lavender soothes and rosemary freshens.

r038.tagline_zh: 男士的下腹与下背养护。
r038.tagline_en: Lower belly and back care for men.
r038.benefit_zh: 久坐久站、下腹和下背觉得沉的男士，用它早晚按摩，让腰腹轻松。
r038.benefit_en: For men who sit or stand all day and feel heavy around the core, massage morning and night for ease.
r038.scene_zh: 早晚涂抹下腹和下背，按揉几分钟。
r038.scene_en: Morning and night, massage into the lower belly and back for a few minutes.
r038.action_zh: 永久花温和，薄荷清凉，薰衣草让人放松。
r038.action_en: Helichrysum is gentle, mint cooling and lavender relaxing.
r038.scent_zh: 蜜香草本，带一点薄荷凉。
r038.scent_en: Honeyed herbs with a cool touch of mint.

r039.benefit_zh: 想用温和的木香照顾私密肌肤，这瓶檀木配方滋润又安心。
r039.benefit_en: For gentle, woody intimate skin care, this sandalwood blend nourishes and reassures.
r039.scene_zh: 早晚洗澡后，涂抹于私密部位的外部肌肤。
r039.scene_en: After showering morning and night, apply to the outer intimate skin.
r039.action_zh: 檀香和愈创木温润，薰衣草让整体柔和。
r039.action_en: Sandalwood and guaiacwood are warm and smooth; lavender softens the blend.
r039.scent_zh: 温暖的木头和一点花香。
r039.scent_en: Warm wood with a little floral.

r040.tagline_zh: 孩子成长期的睡前按摩。
r040.tagline_en: A bedtime massage for growing children.
r040.benefit_zh: 孩子长个子的阶段，腿脚常觉得酸，睡前按摩一下，陪伴也是照顾。
r040.benefit_en: When children are growing and their legs ache, a bedtime massage is care and company at once.
r040.scene_zh: 睡前涂在脊柱、整条腿和脚底，边按边和孩子聊聊天。
r040.scene_en: At bedtime, apply along the spine, the whole leg and the soles while you chat.
r040.action_zh: 乳香温和，丝柏轻快，西伯利亚冷杉的森林香让孩子放松。
r040.action_en: Frankincense is gentle, cypress light and Siberian fir's forest scent helps children relax.
r040.scent_en: Like a walk in the woods.

r041.tagline_en: After a whole day of play.
r041.benefit_zh: 孩子跑跳一天、小腿酸胀，用三种针叶油按摩，让腿脚放松。
r041.benefit_en: After a day of running and jumping, three conifer oils make a relaxing leg massage.
r041.scene_zh: 一天三次，轻轻按摩腿部酸胀的地方。
r041.scene_en: Three times a day, gently massage where the legs feel achy.
r041.action_zh: 三种针叶树精油清新透气，按摩时让人觉得轻松。
r041.action_en: Three conifer oils are fresh and airy and make the massage feel light.

r042.tagline_zh: 手机看久了，后颈要放松。
r042.tagline_en: Too much phone time? Let your neck go.
r042.benefit_zh: 整天低头看手机、电脑，后颈僵硬酸紧，用它按摩后颈让肌肉放松。
r042.benefit_en: Hours of looking down at screens leave the back of the neck stiff; this massage helps it let go.
r042.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹后颈，配合慢慢转动脖子。
r042.scene_en: Apply to the back of the neck three times a day and roll your neck slowly.
r042.action_zh: 柠檬草清爽，苦橙叶放松，永久花温和照顾。
r042.action_en: Lemongrass freshens, petitgrain relaxes and helichrysum gently cares.
r042.scent_zh: 青草和橙叶，带一点蜜香。
r042.scent_en: Grass and orange leaf with a hint of honey.

r043.benefit_zh: 长时间坐着、背部僵硬时，用它沿着脊柱按摩，让背部舒展。
r043.benefit_en: When long sitting stiffens your back, massage along the spine to open it up.
r043.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹脊柱，从下往上推。
r043.scene_en: Three times a day, apply along the spine and stroke upward.
r043.action_zh: 冬青和桦木带清凉感，永久花温和。
r043.action_en: Wintergreen and birch feel cooling; helichrysum is gentle.

r044.tagline_en: A little support for your back.
r044.benefit_zh: 背部常常觉得累、撑不住的时候，用三种木香按摩，配合热敷更舒服。
r044.benefit_en: When your back feels tired and unsupported, a three-wood massage with a warm compress feels great.
r044.scene_zh: 早晚涂抹脊柱，敷上热毛巾 10 分钟。
r044.scene_en: Morning and night along the spine, then a warm towel for 10 minutes.
r044.action_zh: 丝柏轻快，扁柏温暖，西伯利亚冷杉清新，像靠在一棵树上。
r044.action_en: Cypress lightens, arborvitae warms and Siberian fir freshens: like leaning against a tree.

r045.tagline_zh: 后颈和上背，最容易紧的地方。
r045.tagline_en: Where the neck meets the back: the tightest spot.
r045.benefit_zh: 后颈和上背交界处总是紧的人，用它少量多次按摩，让肩膀放下来。
r045.benefit_en: If the base of your neck is always tight, a little often helps your shoulders drop.
r045.scene_zh: 每天少量多次涂抹后颈与上背交界处。
r045.scene_en: A little, several times a day, where the neck meets the upper back.
r045.action_zh: 乳香是主角，温和安定，冬青带清凉，丝柏轻快。
r045.action_en: Frankincense leads, gentle and settling; wintergreen cools and cypress lightens.

r046.tagline_en: Care for the lower back and knees.
r046.benefit_zh: 走多了、站久了，后腰和膝盖觉得酸软，用它按摩让下半身轻松。
r046.benefit_en: When walking or standing leaves your lower back and knees sore, this massage brings relief.
r046.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹后腰和膝盖。
r046.scene_en: Three times a day on the lower back and knees.
r046.action_zh: 芫荽籽温和，薄荷清凉，少量牛至带来强烈的暖意。
r046.action_en: Coriander seed is gentle, mint cools and a little oregano adds strong warmth.
r046.scent_en: Herbal spice with a minty chill.

r047.benefit_zh: 一天下来脚踝沉沉的，用它按摩让脚踝轻盈、走路轻松。
r047.benefit_en: When your ankles feel heavy by day's end, this massage makes them feel light again.
r047.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹脚踝，睡前把脚垫高。
r047.scene_en: Three times a day on the ankles; raise your feet at bedtime.
r047.action_zh: 丝柏轻快，冬青清凉，柠檬草清新。
r047.action_en: Cypress lightens, wintergreen cools and lemongrass freshens.

r048.tagline_en: For legs that have been on the move.
r048.benefit_zh: 运动后或站了一整天，用这瓶清凉配方按摩腿部，让肌肉放松。
r048.benefit_en: After exercise or a day on your feet, this cooling leg massage helps muscles relax.
r048.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹腿部，从脚踝往上推。
r048.scene_en: A little, often, on the legs, stroking up from the ankle.
r048.action_zh: 蓝艾菊清凉舒缓，冬青清爽，柠檬草清新。
r048.action_en: Blue tansy cools and soothes, wintergreen freshens and lemongrass brightens.

r049.tagline_en: Gently relax your arms and legs.
r049.benefit_zh: 四肢紧绷、身体放不开的时候，用这瓶花香按摩，柔和地放松。
r049.benefit_en: When your limbs feel tense and won't let go, this floral massage relaxes them softly.
r049.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹在紧绷的地方。
r049.scene_en: Three times a day where you feel tense.
r049.action_zh: 罗马洋甘菊和薰衣草温和放松，冬青带一点清凉。
r049.action_en: Roman chamomile and lavender relax gently; wintergreen adds coolness.
r049.scent_zh: 苹果般的花香和一点清凉。
r049.scent_en: Apple-like florals with a cool touch.

r050.benefit_zh: 运动后、劳累后肌肉紧绷，用这瓶温和配方按摩，让肌肉舒服地放松。
r050.benefit_en: After exercise or hard work, this gentle blend helps tight muscles relax comfortably.
r050.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹紧绷的肌肉，按完泡个热水澡更好。
r050.scene_en: Three times a day on tight muscles; a warm bath after is even better.
r050.action_zh: 永久花温和，罗马洋甘菊和薰衣草让身心都放松。
r050.action_en: Helichrysum is gentle; Roman chamomile and lavender relax body and mind.
r050.scent_en: Honey and florals, soft and quiet.

r051.benefit_zh: 早上起来关节僵硬、活动不灵活，用它少量多次按摩，让关节舒服一些。
r051.benefit_en: When joints feel stiff in the morning, a little massage often helps them move comfortably.
r051.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹关节，按完慢慢活动。
r051.scene_en: A little, often, on the joints, then move them slowly.
r051.action_zh: 丝柏轻快，乳香温和，生姜带暖意。
r051.action_en: Cypress lightens, frankincense soothes and ginger warms.

r052.tagline_en: A pine-forest massage for the joints.
r052.benefit_zh: 关节常常不舒服的人，用这瓶森林配方按摩，让关节轻松。
r052.benefit_en: For joints that are often uncomfortable, this forest blend makes them feel easier.
r052.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹需要舒缓的关节。
r052.scene_en: A little, often, on the joints that need it.
r052.action_zh: 西伯利亚冷杉清新，冬青清凉，少量牛至带来温热。
r052.action_en: Siberian fir freshens, wintergreen cools and a little oregano warms.

r053.benefit_zh: 关节觉得卡卡的、不灵活，用它早中晚按摩，帮关节活络。
r053.benefit_en: When joints feel stuck, massage morning, noon and night to loosen them up.
r053.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹关节，配合简单的伸展。
r053.scene_en: Three times a day on the joints, with a simple stretch.
r053.action_zh: 西伯利亚冷杉清新，生姜温暖，苦橙叶放松。
r053.action_en: Siberian fir freshens, ginger warms and petitgrain relaxes.
r053.scent_en: Pine needles, ginger and orange leaf.

r054.benefit_zh: 骨节常觉得紧、动起来不舒服，用它按摩让身体舒展开。
r054.benefit_en: When your joints feel tight and movement is uncomfortable, this massage helps you stretch out.
r054.scene_zh: 早晚涂抹并轻轻按摩需要的部位。
r054.scene_en: Morning and night, massage gently where needed.
r054.action_zh: 冬青是主角带清凉，乳香温和，蓝艾菊舒缓。
r054.action_en: Wintergreen leads with coolness, frankincense soothes and blue tansy calms.

r055.benefit_zh: 上下楼梯膝盖觉得沉，用它按摩让膝盖轻松一些。
r055.benefit_en: When stairs make your knees feel heavy, this massage lightens them.
r055.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹膝盖，轻轻打圈。
r055.scene_en: Three times a day, massage the knees in small circles.
r055.action_zh: 甜茴香温暖，丝柏轻快，岩兰草沉稳。
r055.action_en: Sweet fennel warms, cypress lightens and vetiver grounds.

r056.benefit_zh: 久坐后腰臀和腿部紧绷，用它少量多次按摩，让下半身松开。
r056.benefit_en: After long sitting, when hips and legs feel tight, a little often helps them loosen.
r056.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹在腰臀和腿部需要的地方。
r056.scene_en: A little, often, on the hips and legs where needed.
r056.action_zh: 永久花温和，柠檬草清新，冬青清凉。
r056.action_en: Helichrysum is gentle, lemongrass fresh and wintergreen cool.

r057.tagline_en: After a day of carrying it all.
r057.benefit_zh: 背包、抱孩子、提重物之后肩膀酸紧，用这瓶清凉配方按摩肩部。
r057.benefit_en: After bags, children and heavy lifting, this cooling blend eases tired shoulders.
r057.scene_zh: 需要时涂抹肩部，按完转转肩膀。
r057.scene_en: Apply to the shoulders whenever needed, then roll them.
r057.action_zh: 桦木和冬青清凉，西伯利亚冷杉清新，柠檬草提神。
r057.action_en: Birch and wintergreen cool, Siberian fir freshens and lemongrass lifts.

r058.tagline_en: Relax all over, as if walking into the woods.
r058.benefit_zh: 全身都紧、心里也累的时候，用这瓶森林香按摩后背或嗅吸，身心一起放松。
r058.benefit_en: When your whole body is tense and your mind tired, massage or breathe this forest scent to relax both.
r058.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹后背，或者涂在手心深呼吸。
r058.scene_en: Three times a day on the back, or breathe it from your palms.
r058.action_zh: 西伯利亚冷杉和黑云杉清新透气，佛手柑让心情轻快。
r058.action_en: Siberian fir and black spruce open the air; bergamot lightens the mood.
r058.scent_zh: 松林里透进一束柑橘阳光。
r058.scent_en: Pine forest with a shaft of citrus sun.

r059.tagline_en: Wrists that work hard deserve a rest.
r059.benefit_zh: 打字、做家务、用手机多了，手腕觉得酸，用它按摩让手腕舒服。
r059.benefit_en: Typing, chores and phones tire the wrists; this massage helps them feel comfortable.
r059.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹手腕，轻轻转动。
r059.scene_en: Three times a day on the wrists, rotating them gently.
r059.action_zh: 冬青清凉，罗马洋甘菊温和，柠檬草清新。
r059.action_en: Wintergreen cools, Roman chamomile soothes and lemongrass freshens.

r060.tagline_en: A spring massage for the waist.
r060.benefit_zh: 春天万物生长，用这瓶清新的配方按摩腰腹一圈，让身体跟着季节舒展。
r060.benefit_en: In spring, as everything grows, massage a fresh circle around your waist and stretch out with the season.
r060.scene_zh: 早晚涂抹腰腹一圈（带脉位置），慢慢按揉。
r060.scene_en: Morning and night, massage a full circle around the waist.
r060.action_zh: 绿薄荷清新，广藿香和没药沉稳。
r060.action_en: Spearmint freshens; patchouli and myrrh ground.

r061.tagline_en: A summer massage for the waist.
r061.benefit_zh: 夏天胃口差、腰腹闷，用这瓶草本香料按摩，让腰腹清爽。
r061.benefit_en: When summer dulls your appetite and your waist feels stuffy, this herb-and-spice massage freshens it.
r061.scene_zh: 早晚涂抹腰腹一圈，冷气房里也可以用。
r061.scene_en: Morning and night around the waist, even in air conditioning.
r061.action_zh: 罗勒和芫荽籽清爽，檀香温润。
r061.action_en: Basil and coriander seed freshen; sandalwood softens.

r062.tagline_en: An autumn massage for the waist.
r062.benefit_zh: 秋天容易囤积、腰腹沉，用这瓶清爽配方按摩，让身材轻盈。
r062.benefit_en: In autumn, when the waist feels heavier, this fresh massage helps you feel lighter.
r062.scene_en: Morning and night, all the way around the waist.
r062.action_zh: 葡萄柚清爽，丝柏轻快，乳香稳定。
r062.action_en: Grapefruit freshens, cypress lightens and frankincense steadies.

r063.tagline_en: A winter massage for the waist.
r063.benefit_zh: 冬天腰腹容易冷，用这瓶温暖配方按摩一圈，把暖意留在身体中段。
r063.benefit_en: In winter the waist runs cold; this warming circle keeps the heat in your middle.
r063.scene_zh: 早晚涂抹腰腹一圈，按完穿暖。
r063.scene_en: Morning and night around the waist, then dress warmly.
r063.action_zh: 生姜温暖，黑云杉清新，永久花温和。
r063.action_en: Ginger warms, black spruce freshens and helichrysum soothes.
r063.scent_en: Ginger and a snowy pine forest.

r064.benefit_zh: 想让后背线条更紧致、皮肤更好，用它早晚按摩后背。
r064.benefit_en: For a firmer-looking back and better skin, massage the back morning and night.
r064.scene_zh: 早晚请家人帮忙涂抹并按摩后背。
r064.scene_en: Morning and night, ask someone to massage it into your back.
r064.action_zh: 丝柏紧致，乳香照顾皮肤，生姜温暖。
r064.action_en: Cypress tones, frankincense cares for skin and ginger warms.
r064.scent_en: Wood and resin with warm ginger.

r065.tagline_en: A light massage for the belly.
r065.benefit_zh: 想让腹部觉得轻盈，用这瓶清凉香料按摩，配合规律饮食。
r065.benefit_en: For a belly that feels lighter, massage with this cool spice blend alongside regular meals.
r065.scene_zh: 轻轻按摩腹部，注意避开肚脐。
r065.scene_en: Massage the belly gently, avoiding the navel.
r065.action_zh: 椒样薄荷清凉，肉桂温热，芫荽籽温和。
r065.action_en: Peppermint cools, cinnamon warms and coriander seed is gentle.
r065.scent_en: Mint and cinnamon, hot and cold.

r066.tagline_zh: 给饮食均衡的生活一点支持。
r066.tagline_en: A little support for balanced eating.
r066.benefit_zh: 想好好照顾饮食和腹部感受的人，用这瓶清爽香料按摩腹部。
r066.benefit_en: For those caring for their eating and how their belly feels, a fresh spice massage for the belly.
r066.scene_zh: 早晚涂抹腹部，饭后一小时更合适。
r066.scene_en: Apply to the belly morning and night, ideally an hour after a meal.
r066.action_zh: 柠檬清新，甜茴香温和，加州胡椒带暖。
r066.action_en: Lemon freshens, sweet fennel soothes and pink pepper warms.

r067.tagline_en: Daily care for the upper right belly.
r067.benefit_zh: 应酬多、作息乱的人，用这瓶清爽配方照顾右上腹，让身体轻松。
r067.benefit_en: For people with busy social lives and irregular hours, a fresh blend for the upper right belly.
r067.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹右肋下缘。
r067.scene_en: Three times a day along the lower edge of the right ribs.
r067.action_zh: 柠檬清新，天竺葵平衡，永久花温和。
r067.action_en: Lemon freshens, geranium balances and helichrysum soothes.
r067.scent_zh: 柠檬和玫瑰般的绿叶香。

r068.tagline_zh: 清爽轻盈的右上腹护理。
r068.tagline_en: Light, fresh care for the upper right belly.
r068.benefit_zh: 想让身体觉得清爽轻盈，用它早晚照顾右上腹。
r068.benefit_en: For a light, fresh feeling, care for the upper right belly morning and night.
r068.scene_zh: 早晚涂抹右肋下缘，轻轻按揉。
r068.scene_en: Morning and night, massage along the lower right ribs.
r068.action_zh: 没药是主角，天竺葵和永久花温和平衡。
r068.action_en: Myrrh leads; geranium and helichrysum balance it gently.
r068.scent_zh: 树脂香，带玫瑰般的绿叶。

r069.title_en: A Fire for the Lower Back
r069.benefit_zh: 后腰常常发凉、觉得没力气，用它一天三次按摩，让后腰温暖。
r069.benefit_en: When your lower back runs cold and weak, massage three times a day for warmth.
r069.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹后腰，敷热毛巾更舒服。
r069.scene_en: Three times a day on the lower back; a warm towel helps.
r069.action_zh: 檀香温润，芫荽籽温和，少量牛至带强烈的暖。
r069.action_en: Sandalwood is mellow, coriander seed gentle and a little oregano strongly warming.

r070.tagline_en: A warming floral massage for the waist.
r070.benefit_zh: 腰部发凉又想要好闻的按摩，这瓶花香加暖香料两者兼顾。
r070.benefit_en: When your waist is cold but you want a lovely scent, this florals-and-spice blend does both.
r070.scene_en: Apply to the waist morning and night.
r070.action_zh: 依兰花香浓郁，生姜和肉桂温暖。
r070.action_en: Ylang ylang is rich and floral; ginger and cinnamon warm.

r071.title_en: A Warm Stomach, a Calm Mind
r071.tagline_en: For when the upper belly feels off.
r071.benefit_zh: 吃完饭上腹胀闷、胃觉得凉，用它少量多次按摩，让上腹舒服。
r071.benefit_en: When the upper belly feels full and cold after eating, a little massage often brings comfort.
r071.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹左上腹，顺时针轻揉。
r071.scene_en: A little, often, on the upper left belly, clockwise.
r071.action_zh: 芫荽籽温和，道格拉斯冷杉清新，一滴肉桂带暖。
r071.action_en: Coriander seed is gentle, Douglas fir fresh and one drop of cinnamon warms.

r072.tagline_en: Lower belly care for balanced eating.
r072.benefit_zh: 想调整饮食习惯的人，用这瓶柠香按摩小腹，陪你慢慢建立规律。
r072.benefit_en: For those adjusting how they eat, this lemony belly massage keeps you company as you build habits.
r072.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹小腹，配合三餐定时。
r072.scene_en: Three times a day on the lower belly, alongside regular meals.
r072.action_zh: 柠檬清新，枫香沉稳，肉桂温暖。
r072.action_en: Lemon freshens, liquidambar grounds and cinnamon warms.
r072.scent_zh: 柠檬和树脂，带一点肉桂。
r072.scent_en: Lemon and resin with a touch of cinnamon.

r073.tagline_en: Find your energy along the spine.
r073.benefit_zh: 整天没精神、背也挺不起来的时候，沿脊柱按摩让人提起劲。
r073.benefit_en: When you're flat all day and can't sit up straight, a spine massage brings your energy back.
r073.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹脊柱，早上那次最重要。
r073.scene_en: Three times a day along the spine; the morning one matters most.
r073.action_zh: 迷迭香和罗勒提神，岩兰草让活力稳定。
r073.action_en: Rosemary and basil lift; vetiver keeps the energy steady.

r074.tagline_en: A warm bowl before bed in spring and summer.
r074.benefit_zh: 春夏天气热、睡不着，睡前用清凉香气泡脚，让身体慢慢静下来。
r074.benefit_en: When warm nights keep you awake, a cool-scented foot soak helps your body settle.
r074.scene_zh: 涂在手心揉搓整个脚部，再用约 40°C 温水泡到脚踝，泡到鼻尖微微出汗。
r074.scene_en: Rub over your feet, then soak in water around 40°C up to the ankles until you feel a light sweat.
r074.action_zh: 绿薄荷和柠檬尤加利清凉，姜黄温和，泡起来清爽不燥。
r074.action_en: Spearmint and lemon eucalyptus cool; turmeric is mellow, so the soak feels fresh, not hot.

r075.tagline_en: A warm bowl before bed in autumn and winter.
r075.benefit_zh: 秋冬手脚冰冷、躺下很久睡不着，用温暖沉稳的香气泡脚，帮身体入睡。
r075.benefit_en: When cold hands and feet keep you awake in winter, a warm, grounding foot soak helps you drift off.
r075.scene_zh: 涂在手心揉搓整个脚部，再用约 40°C 温水泡到脚踝。
r075.scene_en: Rub over your feet, then soak in water around 40°C up to the ankles.
r075.action_zh: 岩兰草和西伯利亚冷杉沉稳，绿薄荷让呼吸清爽。
r075.action_en: Vetiver and Siberian fir ground you; spearmint keeps breathing fresh.

r076.tagline_zh: 出门在外，肚子也要舒服。
r076.tagline_en: Keep your stomach happy on the road.
r076.benefit_zh: 旅行时饮食、作息一变，肚子就不舒服，带上这瓶随时按摩。
r076.benefit_en: When travel changes your food and routine and your stomach complains, keep this on hand for a quick rub.
r076.scene_zh: 在车上、飞机上、换了饮食后，少量多次涂抹腹部。
r076.scene_en: On the bus, the plane or after new food: a little on the belly, often.
r076.action_zh: 椒样薄荷清凉，甜茴香温和。

r077.tagline_en: Carry it, and your belly stays easy.
r077.benefit_zh: 肚子常常胀胀的人，把这瓶放在包里，需要时涂一涂。
r077.benefit_en: If your belly often feels bloated, keep this in your bag and use as needed.
r077.scene_zh: 需要时涂抹腹部，可以随身携带。
r077.scene_en: Apply to the belly as needed; easy to carry.
r077.action_zh: 薄荷清凉，芫荽籽和茴香温和。
r077.action_en: Mint cools; coriander seed and fennel soothe.

r078.benefit_zh: 双脚闷、容易有气味时，用这瓶清洁感强的配方照顾足部肌肤。
r078.benefit_en: When your feet feel stuffy and smell, this strongly cleansing blend cares for the skin.
r078.scene_zh: 洗脚后擦干，少量多次涂抹需要护理的地方。
r078.scene_en: After washing and drying, apply a little, often, where needed.
r078.action_zh: 茶树清洁，牛至强效，柠檬草清新。
r078.action_en: Tea tree cleanses, oregano is powerful and lemongrass freshens.

r079.tagline_en: For the night you ate too much.
r079.benefit_zh: 聚会、宴席吃多了，回家用它揉揉肚子，让腹部舒服一些。
r079.benefit_en: After a feast, rub your belly with this at home to feel more comfortable.
r079.scene_zh: 回家后涂抹腹部，顺时针按揉几分钟。
r079.scene_en: At home, apply to the belly and massage clockwise for a few minutes.
r079.action_zh: 三种油等量：薄荷清凉，芫荽籽和茴香温和。
r079.action_en: Equal parts: mint cools, coriander seed and fennel soothe.

r080.tagline_zh: 想抽烟的时候，先闻一闻。
r080.benefit_zh: 想戒烟、嘴巴闲不下来的时候，用这瓶清新辛香嗅吸，转移注意力。
r080.benefit_en: When you're quitting and your hands want something, breathe this fresh spice to shift your focus.
r080.scene_zh: 涂在手心嗅吸，随身携带，想抽的时候就闻。
r080.scene_en: Breathe it from your palms; carry it and use it whenever the urge comes.
r080.action_zh: 莱姆清爽，黑胡椒的辛香给人满足感，芫荽叶清新。
r080.action_en: Lime freshens, black pepper's spice feels satisfying and cilantro brightens.
r080.scent_zh: 青柠和黑胡椒，清爽带劲。
r080.scent_en: Lime and black pepper, fresh and punchy.

r081.benefit_zh: 容易出汗、在意体味的人，用这瓶木质清凉配方保持清爽。
r081.benefit_en: If you sweat easily and mind body odour, this cool woody blend keeps you fresh.
r081.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹腋下和腹股沟，可随身携带。
r081.scene_en: A little, often, under the arms and in the groin; easy to carry.
r081.action_zh: 广藿香和檀香留香，椒样薄荷清凉。
r081.action_en: Patchouli and sandalwood linger; peppermint cools.
r081.scent_en: Wood and mint, clean and fresh.

r082.benefit_zh: 户外活动被蚊虫叮咬，用温和的罗马洋甘菊点涂，让肌肤舒服。
r082.benefit_en: After insect bites outdoors, dab on gentle Roman chamomile to soothe the skin.
r082.scene_zh: 点涂在叮咬处和周围，少量多次。
r082.scene_en: Dab on and around the bite, a little, often.
r082.action_zh: 罗马洋甘菊温和，适合敏感肌肤和孩子。
r082.action_en: Roman chamomile is gentle, good for sensitive skin and children.

r083.tagline_zh: 想吃零食之前，先闻一闻。
r083.tagline_en: Before the snack, take a breath.
r083.benefit_zh: 控制饮食时嘴馋，用这瓶清新柑橘香嗅吸，让心情和胃口都稳下来。
r083.benefit_en: When you're watching what you eat and cravings come, breathe this fresh citrus to steady mood and appetite.
r083.scene_zh: 想吃零食时，涂在手心深呼吸几次。
r083.scene_en: When a craving hits, breathe it from your palms a few times.
r083.action_zh: 佛手柑让心情轻快，椒样薄荷清凉，侧柏沉稳。
r083.action_en: Bergamot lifts the mood, peppermint cools and arborvitae grounds.

r085.tagline_en: Ease for the belly after a meal.
r085.benefit_zh: 饭后觉得胀、不消化，用它顺时针按摩腹部，舒畅很多。
r085.benefit_en: When you feel full and slow after eating, a clockwise belly massage makes things easier.
r085.scene_zh: 饭后半小时涂抹腹部，顺时针轻轻按摩。
r085.scene_en: Half an hour after eating, massage the belly gently clockwise.
r085.action_zh: 芫荽是主角温和，椒样薄荷清凉，茴香温暖。
r085.action_en: Coriander leads gently; peppermint cools and fennel warms.

r086.benefit_zh: 腹部常觉得紧、不舒展，用这瓶温和配方早晚按摩。
r086.benefit_en: When your belly often feels tight, massage with this gentle blend morning and night.
r086.scene_zh: 混合均匀后早晚涂抹腹部。
r086.scene_en: Mix well and apply to the belly morning and night.
r086.action_zh: 柠檬清新，甜茴香和生姜温暖。
r086.action_en: Lemon freshens; sweet fennel and ginger warm.

r087.benefit_zh: 私密处外部肌肤觉得不舒服时，用这瓶温和配方轻柔护理。
r087.benefit_en: When the outer intimate skin feels uncomfortable, care for it gently with this mild blend.
r087.scene_zh: 早晚洗澡后，涂抹于需要护理的外部肌肤。
r087.scene_en: After showering morning and night, apply to the outer skin that needs it.
r087.action_zh: 丝柏清爽，天竺葵平衡，永久花温和。
r087.action_en: Cypress freshens, geranium balances and helichrysum soothes.

r088.tagline_zh: 忙起来，肚子也跟着紧张。
r088.tagline_en: When you're busy, your belly tenses too.
r088.benefit_zh: 工作一忙、心一紧，肚子就不舒服的人，用它按摩腹部，身心一起放松。
r088.benefit_en: If stress goes straight to your stomach, a belly massage with this relaxes both.
r088.scene_zh: 需要时涂抹腹部，深呼吸几次。
r088.scene_en: Apply to the belly when needed and take a few deep breaths.
r088.action_zh: 薄荷清凉，佛手柑放松心情，生姜温暖。
r088.action_en: Mint cools, bergamot relaxes the mood and ginger warms.

r089.tagline_en: For a stomach with no set mealtimes.
r089.benefit_zh: 三餐常常错过、胃不舒服的人，用它早晚按摩腹部，照顾肠胃。
r089.benefit_en: If you often skip meals and your stomach suffers, a morning and night belly massage helps.
r089.scene_zh: 早晚涂抹腹部，同时试着按时吃饭。
r089.scene_en: Morning and night on the belly, and try to eat on time.
r089.action_zh: 芫荽籽和茴香温和，薄荷清凉。
r089.action_en: Coriander seed and fennel soothe; mint cools.

r090.benefit_zh: 腹部不太顺畅的时候，用芫荽籽单方早晚按摩。
r090.benefit_en: When things feel slow, massage the belly with coriander seed morning and night.
r090.scene_zh: 早晚涂抹腹部，顺时针按摩。
r090.scene_en: Morning and night, massage the belly clockwise.
r090.action_zh: 芫荽籽温和带甜，是很常用的腹部按摩单方。
r090.action_en: Coriander seed is mild and sweet, a common single oil for belly massage.

r091.tagline_zh: 不舒服的时候，温柔一点。
r091.tagline_en: Be gentle with yourself when it hurts.
r091.benefit_zh: 腹部不舒服、心情也烦躁时，用薰衣草温柔地按摩腹部。
r091.benefit_en: When your belly hurts and your mood frays, massage it softly with lavender.
r091.scene_zh: 不适时涂抹腹部，躺下休息一会。
r091.scene_en: Apply to the belly when uncomfortable and lie down for a while.
r091.action_zh: 薰衣草温和放松，单方就很好用。
r091.action_en: Lavender is gentle and relaxing; it works well on its own.
r091.scent_zh: 干净柔和的薰衣草花香。

r093.tagline_en: One oil for a comfortable belly.
r093.benefit_zh: 想简单照顾腹部，甜茴香单方就能带来舒服的感觉。
r093.benefit_en: For simple belly care, sweet fennel alone brings comfort.
r093.scene_en: Apply to the belly as needed.
r093.action_zh: 甜茴香的甘甜温暖，最适合腹部按摩。
r093.action_en: Sweet fennel's warm sweetness is ideal for belly massage.

r094.benefit_zh: 觉得闷、胃口也不好的时候，闻一闻青柠，整个人清爽起来。
r094.benefit_en: When you feel stuffy and off your food, a breath of lime refreshes you.
r094.scene_zh: 一滴在手心，搓开后嗅吸。
r094.scene_en: One drop in your palms, rub and breathe.
r094.action_zh: 莱姆清新明亮，单方简单直接。
r094.action_en: Lime is bright and clean; simple and direct.

r095.tagline_en: For children who enjoy their meals.
r095.benefit_zh: 孩子胃口不好、吃饭挑剔时，用温和的芫荽籽帮孩子按摩小肚子。
r095.benefit_en: When a child picks at food, a gentle coriander seed tummy massage helps.
r095.scene_zh: 早晚涂抹孩子腹部，顺时针轻揉，边按边说说话。
r095.scene_en: Morning and night, rub your child's tummy clockwise while you chat.
r095.action_zh: 芫荽籽温和带甜，孩子容易接受。
r095.action_en: Coriander seed is mild and sweet, easy for children to enjoy.

r097.benefit_zh: 肠胃敏感、需要很温和照顾的人，用罗马洋甘菊按摩腹部。
r097.benefit_en: For sensitive stomachs that need the gentlest care, massage with Roman chamomile.
r097.scene_zh: 需要时涂抹腹部，轻轻打圈。
r097.scene_en: Apply to the belly as needed in soft circles.
r097.action_zh: 罗马洋甘菊温和舒缓，适合敏感的人。
r097.action_en: Roman chamomile is soothing and gentle on sensitive people.

r098.benefit_zh: 鼻子觉得闷、呼吸不顺的时候，用这瓶清凉配方涂抹鼻周，呼吸舒服一些。
r098.benefit_en: When your nose feels blocked, apply this cool blend around it for easier breathing.
r098.scene_zh: 每天少量多次涂抹鼻周和鼻翼外侧。
r098.scene_en: A little, several times a day, around the nose and outer sides.
r098.action_zh: 尤加利和椒样薄荷清凉通透，茶树清洁。
r098.action_en: Eucalyptus and peppermint feel cool and open; tea tree cleanses.

r099.tagline_en: For dry throats and long talking days.
r099.benefit_zh: 说话多、空气干，喉咙觉得不舒服时，用它涂抹喉咙外侧。
r099.benefit_en: When lots of talking or dry air leaves your throat uncomfortable, apply this to the outside of the throat.
r099.scene_zh: 任选一种精油加入基础油，少量多次涂抹喉咙外侧。
r099.scene_en: Choose one oil, add to carrier oil and apply to the outside of the throat, a little, often.
r099.action_zh: 茶树、柠檬、罗马洋甘菊、没药各有特点，可以按喜好选一种。
r099.action_en: Tea tree, lemon, Roman chamomile and myrrh each have their own character; pick the one you like.
r099.scent_zh: 按你选的油：清新、柑橘、花香或树脂。
r099.scent_en: Depends on your pick: fresh, citrus, floral or resin.

r100.benefit_zh: 两颊和鼻周觉得闷胀时，用这瓶温和清新的配方涂抹两颊。
r100.benefit_en: When your cheeks and sinuses feel full, apply this gentle fresh blend to the cheeks.
r100.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹两侧面颊，避开眼睛。
r100.scene_en: Three times a day on both cheeks, avoiding the eyes.
r100.action_zh: 茶树清洁，柠檬清新，薰衣草温和。
r100.action_en: Tea tree cleanses, lemon freshens and lavender soothes.

r101.tagline_zh: 孩子也适用的鼻周按摩。
r101.tagline_en: A nose massage gentle enough for children.
r101.benefit_zh: 孩子鼻子不通、睡不好时，用温和稀释的配方轻轻按摩鼻周。
r101.benefit_en: When a child's nose is stuffy and sleep suffers, gently massage around the nose with this well-diluted blend.
r101.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹并轻轻按摩鼻子周围，孩子用量要更稀。
r101.scene_en: Three times a day around the nose; dilute more for children.
r101.action_zh: 尤加利通透，丝柏清爽，茶树清洁。
r101.action_en: Eucalyptus opens, cypress freshens and tea tree cleanses.

r102.tagline_zh: 上背和前胸的舒畅涂抹。
r102.tagline_en: An easy-breathing rub for chest and upper back.
r102.benefit_zh: 胸口觉得闷、呼吸不够深的时候，涂抹上背和前胸，让呼吸舒畅。
r102.benefit_en: When your chest feels tight and breathing shallow, rub the chest and upper back for easier breaths.
r102.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹上背和前胸。
r102.scene_en: A little, often, on the chest and upper back.
r102.action_zh: 丁香温暖，没药沉稳，椒样薄荷清凉。
r102.action_en: Clove warms, myrrh grounds and peppermint cools.

r103.benefit_zh: 总觉得呼吸浅、胸口紧的人，用这瓶温暖配方涂抹胸背。
r103.benefit_en: If your breath always feels shallow and your chest tight, rub this warm blend on the chest and back.
r103.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹上背和前胸，配合腹式呼吸。
r103.scene_en: A little, often, on the chest and back, with belly breathing.
r103.action_zh: 姜黄温暖，没药和永久花温和。
r103.action_en: Turmeric warms; myrrh and helichrysum are gentle.

r104.benefit_zh: 夜里鼻子不通、呼吸不顺影响睡眠，睡前用它涂抹或扩香。
r104.benefit_en: When a blocked nose spoils your sleep, apply or diffuse this before bed.
r104.scene_zh: 睡前涂抹鼻周和前胸，或按 4:2:1 比例滴进香薰机。
r104.scene_en: At bedtime, apply around the nose and chest, or diffuse at a 4:2:1 ratio.
r104.action_zh: 尤加利通透，迷迭香清新，西班牙鼠尾草带草本凉意。
r104.action_en: Eucalyptus opens, rosemary freshens and Spanish sage adds herbal coolness.

r105.tagline_en: A fresh throat, wherever you go.
r105.benefit_zh: 喉咙觉得卡卡、不清爽，用它少量多次涂抹喉咙外侧。
r105.benefit_en: When your throat feels scratchy, apply a little to the outside of the throat, often.
r105.scene_zh: 随身携带，少量多次涂抹喉咙外侧。
r105.scene_en: Carry it and apply a little to the outside of the throat, often.
r105.action_zh: 茶树清洁，马郁兰温和，一滴柠檬草提神。
r105.action_en: Tea tree cleanses, marjoram soothes and a drop of lemongrass lifts.
r105.scent_en: Fresh herbs with a grassy note.

r106.tagline_en: A warming rub for cold days.
r106.benefit_zh: 天冷、喉咙和胸口觉得干冷的时候，用这瓶暖香料涂抹胸背和喉咙外侧。
r106.benefit_en: When cold weather leaves your throat and chest feeling dry and chilly, rub this warm spice on chest, back and throat.
r106.scene_zh: 涂抹上背、前胸和喉咙外侧，也可以涂在手心嗅吸。
r106.scene_en: Apply to the upper back, chest and outer throat, or breathe from your palms.
r106.action_zh: 肉桂和豆蔻温暖，西班牙鼠尾草清新。
r106.action_en: Cinnamon and cardamom warm; Spanish sage freshens.
r106.scent_en: Cinnamon and cardamom, like hot chai.

r107.benefit_zh: 想要呼吸畅快、胸口清爽，用它一天三次涂抹前胸。
r107.benefit_en: For open breathing and a clear chest, apply to the chest three times a day.
r107.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹前胸，运动前也适合。
r107.scene_en: Three times a day on the chest; good before exercise too.
r107.action_zh: 迷迭香、尤加利和椒样薄荷，都是清凉通透的叶片香。
r107.action_en: Rosemary, eucalyptus and peppermint are all cool, open leaf scents.

r108.tagline_zh: 换季时的日常防护涂抹。
r108.tagline_en: A daily rub when seasons change.
r108.benefit_zh: 换季时身边很多人不舒服，用这瓶暖香料涂抹后背和脚底，好好照顾自己。
r108.benefit_en: When seasons change and people around you feel unwell, rub this warm spice on your back and soles to look after yourself.
r108.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹后背和足底。
r108.scene_en: Three times a day on the back and soles.
r108.action_zh: 尤加利清新，肉桂和丁香温暖，带清洁感。
r108.action_en: Eucalyptus freshens; cinnamon and clove warm and feel cleansing.

r109.benefit_zh: 天冷容易着凉的时候，用它涂抹后背和脚底，暖身又清爽。
r109.benefit_en: When it's cold and you catch chills easily, rub this on your back and soles to warm up and stay fresh.
r109.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹后背和足底，洗澡后最适合。
r109.scene_en: Three times a day on the back and soles, best after a shower.
r109.action_zh: 茶树清洁，椒样薄荷清凉，少量牛至温热。
r109.action_en: Tea tree cleanses, peppermint cools and a little oregano warms.

r110.benefit_zh: 想要温和一点的换季照顾，这瓶清爽配方适合日常涂抹后背和脚底。
r110.benefit_en: For gentler seasonal care, this fresh blend suits a daily rub on the back and soles.
r110.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹后背和足底。
r110.scene_en: Three times a day on the back and soles.
r110.action_zh: 茶树清洁，芫荽籽和茴香温和。
r110.action_en: Tea tree cleanses; coriander seed and fennel are gentle.

r111.benefit_zh: 喜欢浓郁辛香的人，换季时用它涂抹后背和脚底，温暖有力。
r111.benefit_en: If you love strong spice, rub this on your back and soles when seasons change for warmth and strength.
r111.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹后背和足底，注意多稀释。
r111.scene_en: Three times a day on the back and soles; dilute well.
r111.action_zh: 百里香、肉桂和牛至，都是辛香而有力的油。
r111.action_en: Thyme, cinnamon and oregano are all strong, spicy oils.

r112.title_en: A Cup of Hot Spiced Tea
r112.benefit_zh: 喉咙觉得干冷、不舒服时，用这瓶小比例的暖香料揉搓喉咙外侧。
r112.benefit_en: When your throat feels dry and cold, rub this light, warm spice blend on the outside of the throat.
r112.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹并揉搓喉咙外侧。
r112.scene_en: A little, often, rubbed on the outside of the throat.
r112.action_zh: 豆蔻和尤加利清新温暖，一滴肉桂带出暖意。
r112.action_en: Cardamom and eucalyptus are fresh and warm; one drop of cinnamon brings the heat.

r113.benefit_zh: 换季皮肤干燥、粗糙，用这瓶沉稳木香少量多次滋养肌肤。
r113.benefit_en: When seasonal change leaves skin dry and rough, nourish it with this deep woody blend, a little often.
r113.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹需要护理的肌肤，洗澡后最好。
r113.scene_en: A little, often, on skin that needs it; best after a shower.
r113.action_zh: 岩兰草、没药和檀香都是滋润肌肤的深沉香气。
r113.action_en: Vetiver, myrrh and sandalwood are all deep, nourishing scents for the skin.

r114.tagline_en: Warmth for the joints in cold weather.
r114.benefit_zh: 天一冷关节就不舒服的人，用这瓶温暖配方按摩关节。
r114.benefit_en: If your joints complain whenever it's cold, massage them with this warming blend.
r114.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹关节，按完保暖。
r114.scene_en: Three times a day on the joints, then keep them warm.
r114.action_zh: 乳香是主角温和，百里香和茴香带暖。
r114.action_en: Frankincense leads gently; thyme and fennel add warmth.

r115.benefit_zh: 肌肤偶尔觉得不舒服、需要安抚时，用这瓶清新配方轻轻按摩。
r115.benefit_en: When skin feels unsettled and needs calming, massage gently with this fresh blend.
r115.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹并轻轻按摩需要的部位。
r115.scene_en: Three times a day, massage gently where needed.
r115.action_zh: 香蜂草和柠檬草清新，天竺葵平衡。
r115.action_en: Melissa and lemongrass freshen; geranium balances.

r116.benefit_zh: 外出、坐车、去人多的地方之前，涂抹脖颈，也可以用来清洁双手。
r116.benefit_en: Before going out, travelling or crowded places, apply to your neck, and use it to freshen your hands too.
r116.scene_zh: 出门前涂抹脖颈，随身携带，外出时用于手部清洁护理。
r116.scene_en: Apply to your neck before leaving; carry it to freshen your hands while out.
r116.action_zh: 尤加利清新，丁香和肉桂带清洁感和暖意。
r116.action_en: Eucalyptus freshens; clove and cinnamon feel cleansing and warm.

r117.tagline_zh: 身体发热时的清凉涂抹。
r117.tagline_en: A cooling rub when you feel hot.
r117.benefit_zh: 觉得身体发热、闷热不舒服时，用这瓶清凉配方涂抹后背、额头和脚底。
r117.benefit_en: When you feel hot and uncomfortable, apply this cool blend to your back, forehead and soles.
r117.scene_zh: 涂抹后背、额头和足底，需要时每半小时一次。如果持续发热请就医。
r117.scene_en: Apply to back, forehead and soles, every half hour if needed. See a doctor if a fever persists.
r117.action_zh: 椒样薄荷和尤加利清凉，茶树清洁，乳香和生姜平衡。
r117.action_en: Peppermint and eucalyptus cool, tea tree cleanses, frankincense and ginger balance.

r118.tagline_en: Care for the skin around the lips.
r118.benefit_zh: 唇周肌肤干燥、不舒服时，用这瓶温和花草配方少量多次护理。
r118.benefit_en: When the skin around your lips is dry and uncomfortable, care for it with this gentle blend, a little often.
r118.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹唇周需要护理的地方，避开嘴唇内侧。
r118.scene_en: A little, often, around the lips, avoiding the inner lip.
r118.action_zh: 香蜂草清新，天竺葵平衡，永久花温和。
r118.action_en: Melissa freshens, geranium balances and helichrysum soothes.

r119.benefit_zh: 脸上有色斑、肤色不均匀时，用这瓶温和配方早晚点涂。
r119.benefit_en: For dark spots and uneven tone, dot this gentle blend on morning and night.
r119.scene_zh: 早晚点涂在色斑处，注意避开眼睛，白天做好防晒。
r119.scene_en: Dot on spots morning and night, avoiding the eyes, and wear sunscreen by day.
r119.action_zh: 永久花和薰衣草温和照顾肌肤，一滴丁香带来活力。
r119.action_en: Helichrysum and lavender gently care for skin; a drop of clove adds vitality.

r120.benefit_zh: 有闭口、皮肤不够清透时，用它点涂在需要的地方。
r120.benefit_en: When you have small bumps and skin looks dull, dot this where needed.
r120.scene_zh: 一天三次点涂在闭口处。
r120.scene_en: Dot on bumps three times a day.
r120.action_zh: 岩兰草沉稳，永久花温和，广藿香平衡油脂。
r120.action_en: Vetiver grounds, helichrysum soothes and patchouli balances oil.

r121.tagline_en: Calm for the skin around the nose.
r121.benefit_zh: 鼻周肌肤泛红、敏感时，用这瓶温和配方轻轻护理。
r121.benefit_en: When the skin around your nose is red and sensitive, care for it gently with this mild blend.
r121.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹鼻周需要的地方。
r121.scene_en: Three times a day around the nose where needed.
r121.action_zh: 罗马洋甘菊和永久花温和，没药滋润。
r121.action_en: Roman chamomile and helichrysum are gentle; myrrh nourishes.

r122.tagline_en: Care for skin that carries marks.
r122.benefit_zh: 皮肤上有旧痕迹，想让它看起来淡一些，可以早晚耐心护理。
r122.benefit_en: If you have old marks and want them to look softer, care for them patiently morning and night.
r122.scene_zh: 在手心划两圈混合，早晚涂抹痕迹处。
r122.scene_en: Mix in your palm with two circles and apply to marks morning and night.
r122.action_zh: 乳香、永久花、没药和薰衣草，是照顾肌肤最经典的四种油。
r122.action_en: Frankincense, helichrysum, myrrh and lavender are the four classic skin oils.

r124.tagline_en: Care for the skin of the neck.
r124.benefit_zh: 颈部有细纹、看起来不够紧致时，用它少量多次按摩颈部。
r124.benefit_en: When the neck shows fine lines, massage it a little, often, with this blend.
r124.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹颈部，由下往上推。
r124.scene_en: A little, often, on the neck, stroking upward.
r124.action_zh: 檀香和广藿香滋润，绿薄荷清新。
r124.action_en: Sandalwood and patchouli nourish; spearmint freshens.

r125.benefit_zh: 手脚皮肤皲裂、干到起皮，用这瓶滋润配方少量多次涂抹。
r125.benefit_en: When hands or feet crack and peel, apply this nourishing blend a little, often.
r125.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹皲裂部位，睡前厚涂一次。
r125.scene_en: A little, often, on cracked skin, and a thicker layer at bedtime.
r125.action_zh: 檀香和广藿香滋润，天竺葵平衡。
r125.action_en: Sandalwood and patchouli nourish; geranium balances.

r126.tagline_en: A drink of water for dry skin.
r126.benefit_zh: 皮肤干燥紧绷的时候，用这瓶温和配方一天三次滋润。
r126.benefit_en: When skin feels dry and tight, nourish it three times a day with this gentle blend.
r126.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹干燥的地方。
r126.scene_en: Three times a day on dry areas.
r126.action_zh: 罗马洋甘菊温和，扁柏和生姜带来暖意。
r126.action_en: Roman chamomile soothes; arborvitae and ginger add warmth.

r127.benefit_zh: 身体皮肤干到发痒，用这瓶温和配方轻轻涂抹保湿。
r127.benefit_en: When dry skin starts to itch, moisturise gently with this mild blend.
r127.scene_zh: 早晚轻轻涂抹需要保湿的肌肤。
r127.scene_en: Morning and night, apply gently where skin needs moisture.
r127.action_zh: 檀香是主角滋润，没药和广藿香平衡。
r127.action_en: Sandalwood leads with nourishment; myrrh and patchouli balance.

r128.benefit_zh: 皮肤容易出油、泛光，用这瓶木质配方早晚护理。
r128.benefit_en: If your skin gets oily and shiny, care for it morning and night with this woody blend.
r128.scene_en: Morning and night on oily areas.
r128.action_zh: 雪松、广藿香和檀香，帮助肌肤平衡。
r128.action_en: Cedarwood, patchouli and sandalwood help skin balance.

r130.benefit_zh: 晒太阳后皮肤发热、发红，用这瓶温和花香舒缓。
r130.benefit_en: When skin feels hot and red after the sun, soothe it with this gentle floral blend.
r130.scene_zh: 晒后涂抹在需要的肌肤，避开眼睛。
r130.scene_en: Apply to sun-exposed skin, avoiding the eyes.
r130.action_zh: 薰衣草、罗马洋甘菊和永久花，都是温和舒缓的花。
r130.action_en: Lavender, Roman chamomile and helichrysum are all gentle, soothing flowers.

r131.benefit_zh: 想让手臂、大腿的皮肤更光滑，用它一天三次按摩。
r131.benefit_en: For smoother arms and thighs, massage three times a day.
r131.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹并按摩需要的地方。
r131.scene_en: Massage where needed three times a day.
r131.action_zh: 杜松浆果清爽，柠檬明亮，加州胡椒带暖。
r131.action_en: Juniper berry freshens, lemon brightens and pink pepper warms.

r132.benefit_zh: 脚后跟干裂、走路都不舒服，用这瓶滋润配方少量多次涂抹。
r132.benefit_en: When cracked heels make walking uncomfortable, apply this nourishing blend a little, often.
r132.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹脚后跟，睡前涂完穿上袜子。
r132.scene_en: A little, often, on the heels; at bedtime, put socks on after.
r132.action_zh: 没药和檀香滋润，天竺葵平衡。
r132.action_en: Myrrh and sandalwood nourish; geranium balances.

r133.benefit_zh: 想延缓肌肤老化、保持弹性，用这瓶配方早中晚照顾脸和颈。
r133.benefit_en: To help skin stay supple and young-looking, care for face and neck three times a day.
r133.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹脸部和颈部，避开眼睛。
r133.scene_en: Three times a day on face and neck, avoiding the eyes.
r133.action_zh: 西洋蓍草和乳香照顾肌肤，丁香带来活力。
r133.action_en: Yarrow and frankincense care for skin; clove adds vitality.
r133.scent_en: Herbs, resin and a little spice.

r134.benefit_zh: 干性肌肤细纹明显，用这三种等量的油早晚抚平。
r134.benefit_en: For fine lines on dry skin, smooth them morning and night with three oils in equal parts.
r134.scene_zh: 在手心划两圈混合，涂抹细纹处，避开眼睛。
r134.scene_en: Mix in your palm with two circles and apply to lines, avoiding the eyes.
r134.action_zh: 乳香、古巴香脂和永久花等量，温和滋润。
r134.action_en: Equal frankincense, copaiba and helichrysum: gentle and nourishing.

r135.benefit_zh: 油性肌肤也有细纹，用这三种等量的油早晚护理，滋润不油腻。
r135.benefit_en: Oily skin gets fine lines too; care for it morning and night with three equal oils that nourish without grease.
r135.scene_zh: 在手心划两圈混合，涂抹细纹处，避开眼睛。
r135.scene_en: Mix in your palm with two circles and apply to lines, avoiding the eyes.
r135.action_zh: 没药、广藿香和檀香等量，平衡又滋润。
r135.action_en: Equal myrrh, patchouli and sandalwood: balancing and nourishing.

r136.tagline_en: Care for stretch marks and dimpling.
r136.benefit_zh: 产后妊娠纹、大腿的橘皮组织，用这瓶配方少量多次按摩。
r136.benefit_en: For stretch marks after pregnancy and dimpled skin on the thighs, massage a little, often.
r136.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹并按摩需要的地方。
r136.scene_en: A little, often, massaged where needed.
r136.action_zh: 丝柏紧致，乳香照顾肌肤，生姜温暖。
r136.action_en: Cypress tones, frankincense cares for skin and ginger warms.

r137.benefit_zh: 冬天皮肤干冷、容易粗糙，用这瓶滋润木香少量多次护理。
r137.benefit_en: When winter leaves skin dry, cold and rough, care for it with this rich woody blend, a little often.
r137.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹需要护理的肌肤。
r137.scene_en: A little, often, on skin that needs it.
r137.action_zh: 没药、广藿香和檀香，深层滋润。
r137.action_en: Myrrh, patchouli and sandalwood nourish deeply.

r139.benefit_zh: 皮肤摸起来粗糙、不平滑，用它少量多次按摩。
r139.benefit_en: When skin feels rough and uneven, massage a little, often.
r139.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹并轻轻按摩。
r139.action_zh: 没药和岩兰草滋润，丁香带来活力。
r139.action_en: Myrrh and vetiver nourish; clove adds vitality.

r140.benefit_zh: 脚上的硬茧让走路不舒服，用这两滴油点涂护理。
r140.benefit_en: When calluses make walking uncomfortable, dot on these two drops.
r140.scene_zh: 点涂在硬皮处，洗澡后皮肤软的时候最好。
r140.scene_en: Dot onto hard skin, best after a bath when skin is soft.
r140.action_zh: 丁香温暖，椒样薄荷清凉。

r141.benefit_zh: 指甲和甲周需要清洁照顾时，用这瓶强效草本配方护理。
r141.benefit_en: When nails and the skin around them need cleansing care, use this strong herbal blend.
r141.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹指甲和周围。
r141.scene_en: Three times a day on nails and surrounding skin.
r141.action_zh: 牛至和百里香清洁感强，茶树温和。
r141.action_en: Oregano and thyme are strongly cleansing; tea tree is gentler.

r142.tagline_en: Care for hard skin and cuticles.
r142.benefit_zh: 指缘硬皮、倒刺多，用檀香单方少量多次滋润。
r142.benefit_en: For hard cuticles and hangnails, nourish a little, often, with sandalwood.
r142.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹指缘和硬皮。
r142.scene_en: A little, often, on cuticles and hard skin.
r142.action_zh: 檀香温润滋养，单方就够。
r142.action_en: Sandalwood is smooth and nourishing; it works alone.

r143.benefit_zh: 指甲脆、长得慢，用柠檬少量多次涂抹指甲和周围。
r143.benefit_en: For brittle, slow-growing nails, apply lemon to nails and cuticles a little, often.
r143.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹指甲和周围皮肤，涂完不要揉眼睛。
r143.scene_en: A little, often, on nails and surrounding skin; don't rub your eyes after.
r143.action_zh: 柠檬清新明亮，照顾指甲。
r143.action_en: Lemon is bright and fresh, good for nails.

r144.benefit_zh: 宝宝小屁屁的皮肤需要很温柔的照顾，选一种温和的油高度稀释后涂抹。
r144.benefit_en: Baby's bottom needs the gentlest care; choose one mild oil and dilute it well.
r144.scene_zh: 任选一种精油加入基础油，少量多次涂抹，用量要比大人少很多。
r144.scene_en: Choose one oil, add to carrier oil and apply a little, often; use far less than for adults.
r144.action_zh: 罗马洋甘菊和薰衣草最温和，茶树和侧柏清洁感较强。
r144.action_en: Roman chamomile and lavender are the gentlest; tea tree and arborvitae are more cleansing.
r144.scent_zh: 按你选的油：花香或木香。
r144.scent_en: Depends on your pick: floral or woody.

r145.benefit_zh: 肌肤需要净护时，选永久花或岩兰草加入基础油护理。
r145.benefit_en: When skin needs clean care, choose helichrysum or vetiver in a carrier oil.
r145.scene_zh: 任选一种加入基础油，少量多次涂抹。
r145.scene_en: Choose one, add to carrier oil and apply a little, often.
r145.action_zh: 永久花温和，岩兰草沉稳。

r146.benefit_zh: 敏感肌容易泛红、不舒服，用两种油分开护理，内外兼顾。
r146.benefit_en: When sensitive skin reddens easily, two oils used separately care for it from two angles.
r146.scene_zh: 天竺葵 36 滴加入基础油涂足底；永久花 36 滴加入基础油涂需要护理的肌肤。
r146.scene_en: 36 drops geranium in carrier oil for the soles; 36 drops helichrysum in carrier oil for the skin that needs it.
r146.action_zh: 天竺葵平衡，永久花温和舒缓。

r147.benefit_zh: 肌肤偶尔发痒、不舒服时，用这瓶温和配方安抚。
r147.benefit_en: When skin itches or feels unsettled, calm it with this gentle blend.
r147.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹需要的地方。
r147.scene_en: Three times a day where needed.
r147.action_zh: 薰衣草和罗马洋甘菊温和，茶树清洁。
r147.action_en: Lavender and Roman chamomile soothe; tea tree cleanses.

r148.benefit_zh: 皮肤发热、不舒服时，用这瓶清凉配方轻轻按摩。
r148.benefit_en: When skin feels hot and uncomfortable, massage gently with this cooling blend.
r148.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹并轻轻按摩。
r148.scene_en: Massage gently three times a day.
r148.action_zh: 椒样薄荷清凉，茶树清洁，薰衣草温和。
r148.action_en: Peppermint cools, tea tree cleanses and lavender soothes.

r149.tagline_zh: 需要马上打起精神的时候。
r149.tagline_en: For when you need to perk up now.
r149.benefit_zh: 开车、开会、熬夜后需要马上清醒，用这瓶清凉配方涂抹头部和脚底。
r149.benefit_en: Driving, meetings or after a late night: apply this cool blend to head and soles to wake up fast.
r149.scene_zh: 涂抹头部和脚底，也可以闻一闻手心。
r149.scene_en: Apply to head and soles, or breathe from your palms.
r149.action_zh: 椒样薄荷和尤加利清凉提神，乳香让清醒更稳定。
r149.action_en: Peppermint and eucalyptus wake you up; frankincense keeps it steady.

r150.benefit_zh: 压力大、头部紧绷，用它轻轻按摩紧的地方，让头部放松。
r150.benefit_en: When stress tightens your head, massage the tense spots gently to relax.
r150.scene_zh: 涂抹并轻轻按摩头部紧绷处，可以随身携带。
r150.scene_en: Massage gently where your head feels tight; easy to carry.
r150.action_zh: 椒样薄荷清凉，马郁兰温和放松，芫荽叶清新。
r150.action_en: Peppermint cools, marjoram relaxes and cilantro freshens.

r151.benefit_zh: 想让牙龈清爽、口气清新，用这瓶配方日常护理。
r151.benefit_en: For fresh gums and breath, use this blend as daily care.
r151.scene_zh: 用干净的手指蘸取，一天三次涂抹牙龈。
r151.scene_en: With a clean finger, apply to the gums three times a day.
r151.action_zh: 丁香温暖，茶树清洁，古巴香脂温和。
r151.action_en: Clove warms, tea tree cleanses and copaiba soothes.

r152.benefit_zh: 日常照顾牙龈和口气，用这瓶清凉配方简单好用。
r152.benefit_en: For everyday gum care and fresh breath, this cool blend is simple to use.
r152.scene_zh: 用干净的手指蘸取，一天三次涂抹牙龈。
r152.scene_en: With a clean finger, apply to the gums three times a day.
r152.action_zh: 椒样薄荷和绿薄荷清凉，一滴没药照顾牙龈。
r152.action_en: Peppermint and spearmint cool; one drop of myrrh cares for gums.

r153.tagline_en: For those who clench at night.
r153.benefit_zh: 夜里咬牙、下颌紧绷，睡前选一种放松的油涂抹下巴周围或扩香。
r153.benefit_en: If you clench at night and your jaw feels tight, apply or diffuse a relaxing oil before bed.
r153.scene_zh: 任选一种加入基础油涂抹下巴周围，或 2–4 滴扩香。
r153.scene_en: Choose one, add to carrier oil and apply around the jaw, or diffuse 2–4 drops.
r153.action_zh: 薰衣草、檀香、雪松、罗马洋甘菊都让人放松，按喜好选。
r153.action_en: Lavender, sandalwood, cedarwood and Roman chamomile all relax; pick your favourite.
r153.scent_zh: 按你选的油：花香或木香。
r153.scent_en: Depends on your pick: floral or woody.

r154.tagline_zh: 面部和头部的舒展按摩。
r154.tagline_en: An opening massage for face and head.
r154.benefit_zh: 一天下来脸和头都绷着，用它少量多次按摩，让表情放松。
r154.benefit_en: When your face and head have been tense all day, massage a little often to soften.
r154.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹头部，轻轻按摩。
r154.scene_en: A little, often, massaged into the head.
r154.action_zh: 椒样薄荷清凉，乳香温和，马郁兰放松。
r154.action_en: Peppermint cools, frankincense soothes and marjoram relaxes.

r155.benefit_zh: 睡得浅、容易醒、梦多，睡前用这瓶沉稳配方涂抹或扩香。
r155.benefit_en: For light sleep, waking often or busy dreams, apply or diffuse this grounding blend before bed.
r155.scene_zh: 睡前涂抹头部和脚底，或按 1:1:1 比例扩香。
r155.scene_en: At bedtime, apply to head and soles, or diffuse at 1:1:1.
r155.action_zh: 岩兰草沉稳，乳香安定，天竺葵平衡。
r155.action_en: Vetiver grounds, frankincense settles and geranium balances.

r156.benefit_zh: 孩子坐不住、注意力难集中时，选一种沉稳的油涂抹脊柱。
r156.benefit_en: When a child can't sit still or focus, apply a grounding oil along the spine.
r156.scene_zh: 任选一种加入基础油涂抹脊柱，几种可以交替使用。
r156.scene_en: Choose one, add to carrier oil and apply to the spine; you can rotate them.
r156.action_zh: 乳香、檀香、岩兰草、广藿香都是让人安定的木质与根部香气。
r156.action_en: Frankincense, sandalwood, vetiver and patchouli are all grounding wood and root scents.
r156.scent_zh: 按你选的油：树脂、木香或泥土。
r156.scent_en: Depends on your pick: resin, wood or earth.

r157.tagline_zh: 躺下很久睡不着的时候。
r157.benefit_zh: 躺下后脑子还在转、很久睡不着，睡前用它涂抹或扩香，帮自己放下。
r157.benefit_en: When your mind keeps going long after you lie down, apply or diffuse this before bed to let go.
r157.scene_zh: 睡前涂抹头部和脚底，或按 3:2:1 比例扩香。
r157.scene_en: At bedtime, apply to head and soles, or diffuse at 3:2:1.
r157.action_zh: 岩兰草沉稳，马郁兰放松，薰衣草温柔。
r157.action_en: Vetiver grounds, marjoram relaxes and lavender soothes.

r158.benefit_zh: 白天压力大、晚上睡不着，用这瓶配方睡前涂抹或扩香，让心安下来。
r158.benefit_en: When daytime stress keeps you awake, apply or diffuse this before bed to settle your heart.
r158.scene_zh: 睡前涂抹头部和脚底，或按 1:2:1 比例扩香。
r158.scene_en: At bedtime, apply to head and soles, or diffuse at 1:2:1.
r158.action_zh: 岩兰草是主角沉稳，薰衣草和罗马洋甘菊温柔。
r158.action_en: Vetiver leads with grounding; lavender and Roman chamomile soften.

r159.benefit_zh: 半夜容易醒、醒了又睡不着，睡前用这瓶花香配方涂抹或扩香。
r159.benefit_en: If you wake in the night and can't drift off again, apply or diffuse this floral blend before bed.
r159.scene_zh: 睡前涂抹头部和脚底，或按 1:3:2 比例扩香。
r159.scene_en: At bedtime, apply to head and soles, or diffuse at 1:3:2.
r159.action_zh: 罗马洋甘菊温柔，依兰放松，广藿香沉稳。
r159.action_en: Roman chamomile soothes, ylang ylang relaxes and patchouli grounds.

r160.tagline_en: A scalp massage for a clear mind.
r160.benefit_zh: 脑子发闷、需要专注的时候，用它少量多次按摩头皮。
r160.benefit_en: When your head feels dull and you need to focus, massage the scalp a little, often.
r160.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹头皮，用指腹按揉。
r160.scene_en: A little, often, massaged into the scalp with your fingertips.
r160.action_zh: 迷迭香清醒，乳香稳定，一点茴香温和。
r160.action_en: Rosemary clears, frankincense steadies and a little fennel softens.

r161.tagline_en: For when you need your brain.
r161.benefit_zh: 写报告、做计划、考试前需要清楚的思路，用它嗅吸并涂太阳穴。
r161.benefit_en: Before reports, planning or exams, breathe this and dab your temples for clear thinking.
r161.scene_zh: 涂在手心嗅吸，再涂抹太阳穴，一天三次。
r161.scene_en: Breathe from your palms, then dab your temples, three times a day.
r161.action_zh: 迷迭香和椒样薄荷清醒，乳香让专注稳定。
r161.action_en: Rosemary and peppermint clear; frankincense steadies focus.

r162.tagline_en: Helping children feel safe at school.
r162.benefit_zh: 孩子上学前紧张、舍不得离开，在衣领上点一点，让熟悉的香气陪着他。
r162.benefit_en: When a child is nervous about school, a dab on the collar lets a familiar scent go with them.
r162.scene_zh: 可以扩香，也可以涂在孩子的衣领上。
r162.scene_en: Diffuse it, or dab it on your child's collar.
r162.action_zh: 野橘让人开心，迷迭香清醒，一滴椒样薄荷提神。
r162.action_en: Wild orange cheers, rosemary clears and one drop of peppermint perks up.

r163.benefit_zh: 需要长时间专注时，用它涂太阳穴、手腕和后颈，把注意力拉回来。
r163.benefit_en: When you need to focus for a long time, dab temples, wrists and neck to bring your attention back.
r163.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹太阳穴、手腕和后颈。
r163.scene_en: A little, often, on temples, wrists and the back of the neck.
r163.action_zh: 椒样薄荷是主角，尤加利清新，一滴檀香稳定。
r163.action_en: Peppermint leads, eucalyptus freshens and one drop of sandalwood steadies.

r164.benefit_zh: 长辈头部常觉得不舒服、需要被照顾，用这瓶温和配方按摩头皮，也是一种陪伴。
r164.benefit_en: When elders' heads need care, massaging their scalp with this gentle blend is also time together.
r164.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹头皮，慢慢按摩。
r164.scene_en: A little, often, massaged slowly into the scalp.
r164.action_zh: 古巴香脂和没药温和，永久花舒缓。
r164.action_en: Copaiba and myrrh are gentle; helichrysum soothes.

r165.benefit_zh: 背部长期紧绷的人，用它一天三次涂抹脊柱，慢慢放松。
r165.benefit_en: If your back is always tight, apply along the spine three times a day to slowly release.
r165.scene_en: Three times a day along the spine.
r165.action_zh: 马郁兰放松，乳香温和，丝柏轻快。
r165.action_en: Marjoram relaxes, frankincense soothes and cypress lightens.

r166.benefit_zh: 早上起来手脚冰冷、提不起劲，用它涂心前区和脚底，让身体暖起来。
r166.benefit_en: When mornings start with cold hands and no energy, apply over the heart and soles to warm up.
r166.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹心前区和足底，早上那次最重要。
r166.scene_en: Three times a day over the heart and on the soles; the morning one matters most.
r166.action_zh: 快乐鼠尾草是主角，迷迭香清醒，柠檬明亮。
r166.action_en: Clary sage leads, rosemary clears and lemon brightens.

r167.benefit_zh: 容易心慌、心里不静的时候，用这瓶花香配方涂耳后和脚底。
r167.benefit_en: When your heart races and your mind won't settle, apply this floral blend behind the ears and on the soles.
r167.scene_zh: 涂抹耳后沟和脚底，并轻轻按摩。
r167.scene_en: Apply behind the ears and to the soles, massaging gently.
r167.action_zh: 薰衣草和依兰放松，香蜂草清新。
r167.action_en: Lavender and ylang ylang relax; melissa freshens.

r168.benefit_zh: 颈部常觉得紧、不流畅，用它早晚按摩颈部两侧。
r168.benefit_en: When your neck feels tight and stuck, massage both sides morning and night.
r168.scene_zh: 早晚涂抹并轻轻按摩颈部两侧。
r168.scene_en: Morning and night, massage both sides of the neck.
r168.action_zh: 柠檬草清新，永久花温和，香蜂草带柠檬香。
r168.action_en: Lemongrass freshens, helichrysum soothes and melissa adds a lemony note.

r169.tagline_zh: 头部与循环的日常养护。
r169.tagline_en: Daily care for the head and circulation.
r169.benefit_zh: 头部常觉得沉、胸口也闷，用它一天三次涂头部和心前区。
r169.benefit_en: When your head feels heavy and chest stuffy, apply to head and over the heart three times a day.
r169.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹头部和心前区。
r169.scene_en: Three times a day on the head and over the heart.
r169.action_zh: 丝柏轻快，永久花温和，柠檬草清新。
r169.action_en: Cypress lightens, helichrysum soothes and lemongrass freshens.

r170.benefit_zh: 胸口常觉得闷、心情也压着，用这瓶花香配方涂抹前胸。
r170.benefit_en: When your chest feels heavy and so does your mood, apply this floral blend to the chest.
r170.scene_en: Three times a day on the chest.
r170.action_zh: 依兰依兰是主角放松，柠檬草清新，永久花温和。
r170.action_en: Ylang ylang leads with relaxation; lemongrass freshens and helichrysum soothes.

r171.benefit_zh: 胸口觉得凉、心里也空的时候，用这瓶温暖树脂配方涂抹前胸。
r171.benefit_en: When your chest feels cold and your heart empty, apply this warm resin blend to the chest.
r171.scene_en: Three times a day on the chest.
r171.action_zh: 乳香和古巴香脂温暖沉稳，柠檬草清新。
r171.action_en: Frankincense and copaiba are warm and steady; lemongrass freshens.

r172.benefit_zh: 久站久坐、腿部沉重浮肿，用它早晚按摩腿部和腰部。
r172.benefit_en: When standing or sitting leaves your legs heavy and puffy, massage legs and waist morning and night.
r172.scene_zh: 早晚涂抹腿部需要的地方和腰部，从下往上推。
r172.scene_en: Morning and night on the legs and waist, stroking upward.
r172.action_zh: 丝柏是主角轻快，生姜温暖，柠檬草清新。
r172.action_en: Cypress leads with lightness; ginger warms and lemongrass freshens.

r174.tagline_en: Wake up your sense of smell.
r174.benefit_zh: 闻东西变得迟钝时，用这几种特点鲜明的香气练习嗅觉。
r174.benefit_en: When your sense of smell feels dulled, practise with these distinctive scents.
r174.scene_zh: 涂抹鼻周并涂于手心嗅吸，少量多次；或按 5:1:2 比例扩香。
r174.scene_en: Apply around the nose and breathe from your palms, a little often; or diffuse at 5:1:2.
r174.action_zh: 椒样薄荷、丁香和茴香，三种香气很不一样，适合嗅觉练习。
r174.action_en: Peppermint, clove and fennel smell very different, which makes them good for smell training.

r175.tagline_en: A soothing massage around the eyes.
r175.benefit_zh: 眼睛累、眼周不舒服时，用这瓶配方高度稀释后涂抹眼眶周围。
r175.benefit_en: When your eyes are tired and the area around them uncomfortable, apply this well-diluted blend around the eye socket.
r175.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹眼眶周围，一定避开眼睛。
r175.scene_en: Three times a day around the eye socket; always avoid the eyes.
r175.action_zh: 茶树清洁，乳香和永久花温和。
r175.action_en: Tea tree cleanses; frankincense and helichrysum are gentle.

r176.benefit_zh: 看屏幕多、眼周显得疲惫，用它少量多次涂抹眼眶周围。
r176.benefit_en: When screens leave your eyes looking tired, apply a little around the eye socket, often.
r176.scene_zh: 每天少量多次涂抹眼眶周围，避开眼睛。
r176.scene_en: A little, often, around the eye socket, avoiding the eyes.
r176.action_zh: 永久花是主角，丝柏轻快，乳香温和。
r176.action_en: Helichrysum leads; cypress lightens and frankincense soothes.

r177.benefit_zh: 早上起来眼周浮肿，用葡萄柚少量多次涂抹眼眶周围。
r177.benefit_en: When you wake with puffy eyes, apply grapefruit around the eye socket, a little often.
r177.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹眼眶周围，注意避开眼睛，白天避免日晒。
r177.scene_en: A little, often, around the eye socket, avoiding the eyes, and avoid sun on the area.
r177.action_en: Grapefruit is fresh and simple on its own.

r178.benefit_zh: 熬夜后黑眼圈明显，用这瓶温和配方少量多次涂抹眼眶周围。
r178.benefit_en: When late nights show as dark circles, apply this gentle blend around the eye socket, a little often.
r178.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹眼眶周围，避开眼睛。
r178.scene_en: A little, often, around the eye socket, avoiding the eyes.
r178.action_zh: 永久花是主角，罗马洋甘菊和没药温和。
r178.action_en: Helichrysum leads; Roman chamomile and myrrh are gentle.

r179.benefit_zh: 眼袋明显、看起来疲倦，用这瓶清爽配方少量多次涂抹。
r179.benefit_en: When under-eye bags make you look tired, apply this fresh blend a little, often.
r179.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹眼袋部位，避开眼睛，白天避免日晒。
r179.scene_en: A little, often, on the bags, avoiding the eyes, and avoid sun on the area.
r179.action_zh: 丝柏和葡萄柚清爽，乳香温和。
r179.action_en: Cypress and grapefruit freshen; frankincense soothes.

r180.benefit_zh: 把眼周护理变成每天的小习惯，用这瓶温和配方少量多次涂抹。
r180.benefit_en: Make eye-area care a small daily habit with this gentle blend, a little often.
r180.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹眼眶周围，避开眼睛。
r180.scene_en: A little, often, around the eye socket, avoiding the eyes.
r180.action_zh: 永久花温和，丝柏轻快，乳香稳定。
r180.action_en: Helichrysum soothes, cypress lightens and frankincense steadies.

r181.benefit_zh: 眼周肌肤敏感，用这瓶温和配方一天三次轻轻护理。
r181.benefit_en: For sensitive skin around the eyes, care gently three times a day with this mild blend.
r181.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹眼周，避开眼皮和眼睛。
r181.scene_en: Three times a day around the eyes, avoiding the lids and eyes.
r181.action_zh: 乳香和薰衣草温和，一滴丁香带活力。
r181.action_en: Frankincense and lavender soothe; a drop of clove adds vitality.

r182.benefit_zh: 眼周干燥、有细纹，用它一天三次轻轻按摩眼眶周围。
r182.benefit_en: When the eye area is dry and lined, massage gently around the eye socket three times a day.
r182.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹并轻轻按摩眼眶周围，避开眼睛。
r182.scene_en: Three times a day, massage gently around the eye socket, avoiding the eyes.
r182.action_zh: 乳香和永久花滋润，茶树清洁。
r182.action_en: Frankincense and helichrysum nourish; tea tree cleanses.

r183.tagline_en: A caring massage around the eyes.
r183.benefit_zh: 眼睛累了一天，用这瓶沉稳配方按摩眼眶周围，也让心静下来。
r183.benefit_en: After a long day for your eyes, massage around them with this grounding blend and let your mind quiet too.
r183.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹并轻轻按摩眼眶周围，避开眼睛。
r183.scene_en: Three times a day, massage gently around the eye socket, avoiding the eyes.
r183.action_zh: 古巴香脂是主角温和，乳香和岩兰草沉稳。
r183.action_en: Copaiba leads gently; frankincense and vetiver ground.

r184.benefit_zh: 眼周觉得闷、看起来沉，用这瓶清爽配方按摩。
r184.benefit_en: When the eye area feels heavy, massage with this fresh blend.
r184.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹并轻轻按摩眼眶周围，避开眼睛，白天避免日晒。
r184.scene_en: Three times a day around the eye socket, avoiding the eyes, and avoid sun on the area.
r184.action_zh: 乳香、丝柏和葡萄柚等量，清爽又温和。
r184.action_en: Equal frankincense, cypress and grapefruit: fresh yet gentle.

r185.tagline_en: A relaxing massage around the ears.
r185.benefit_zh: 耳朵周围紧绷、头也跟着累，用它随时按摩耳周，让人放松。
r185.benefit_en: When the area around your ears feels tight and your head tired, massage it any time to relax.
r185.scene_zh: 随时涂抹并轻轻按摩耳朵周围，不要滴进耳内。
r185.scene_en: Massage gently around the ears any time; never drop into the ear.
r185.action_zh: 西伯利亚冷杉和黑云杉清新，蓝艾菊舒缓。
r185.action_en: Siberian fir and black spruce freshen; blue tansy soothes.

r187.benefit_zh: 耳朵周围常觉得不舒服、需要安静，用它一天三次按摩耳周。
r187.benefit_en: When the ears often feel uncomfortable and you crave quiet, massage around them three times a day.
r187.scene_zh: 一天三次涂抹耳朵周围，不要滴进耳内。
r187.scene_en: Three times a day around the ears; never drop into the ear.
r187.action_zh: 乳香和永久花温和，岩兰草沉稳。
r187.action_en: Frankincense and helichrysum soothe; vetiver grounds.

r188.benefit_zh: 嘴唇干到起皮、裂开，用薰衣草稀释后少量多次涂抹。
r188.benefit_en: When lips are dry, peeling and cracked, apply diluted lavender a little, often.
r188.scene_zh: 少量多次涂抹唇部皮肤。
r188.scene_en: A little, often, on the lips.
r188.action_zh: 薰衣草温和舒缓，单方就够。
r188.action_en: Lavender is gentle and soothing on its own.

r189.benefit_zh: 口腔需要清新照顾时，用这瓶柑橘草本配方点涂。
r189.benefit_en: When your mouth needs freshening, dot on this citrus-herb blend.
r189.scene_zh: 用干净的手指蘸取，少量多次点涂口腔内需要的地方。
r189.scene_en: With a clean finger, dot a little where needed inside the mouth, often.
r189.action_zh: 野橘和山鸡椒清新，香蜂草带柠檬香。
r189.action_en: Wild orange and litsea freshen; melissa adds lemon.

g01.tagline_zh: 孩子的成长与换季养护。
g01.tagline_en: Growth and seasonal care for children.
g01.benefit_zh: 孩子长个子、又碰上换季，用这瓶大瓶配方早晚涂后背和脚底，一瓶顾两样。
g01.benefit_en: When children are growing and seasons change, this large blend on the back and soles morning and night covers both.
g01.scene_zh: 每天早晚涂抹后背脊柱和脚底，睡前那次可以配一个故事。
g01.scene_en: Morning and night on the spine and soles; pair the bedtime one with a story.
g01.action_zh: 芳香调理、乳香、冷杉照顾成长；保卫、生姜、永久花照顾换季。
g01.action_en: AromaTouch, frankincense and fir for growing; On Guard, ginger and helichrysum for the seasons.

g02.tagline_en: Soothing care for throat, chest and back.
g02.benefit_zh: 喉咙和胸口一起不舒服，用这瓶多种油的配方涂脖颈、前胸和后背。
g02.benefit_en: When throat and chest feel uncomfortable together, apply this rich blend to the neck, chest and back.
g02.scene_zh: 涂抹脖颈到前胸，以及后背。
g02.scene_en: Apply from neck to chest, and on the back.
g02.action_zh: 顺畅呼吸和薄荷通透，保卫和牛至带清洁感，香蜂草和乳香温和。
g02.action_en: Easy Air and mint open, On Guard and oregano feel cleansing, melissa and frankincense soothe.

g03.benefit_zh: 孩子肚子常常不舒服，用这瓶温和大瓶配方一天几次涂抹。
g03.benefit_en: When a child's tummy is often unsettled, apply this gentle large blend several times a day.
g03.scene_zh: 一日数次涂抹胃腹部。排便不畅时顺时针按摩，便稀时逆时针按摩。
g03.scene_en: Several times a day on the tummy: clockwise when things are slow, anticlockwise when loose.
g03.action_zh: 乐活复方是主角，红橘和罗马洋甘菊温柔，生姜和广藿香温暖。
g03.action_en: ZenGest leads; red mandarin and Roman chamomile soothe, ginger and patchouli warm.
g03.scent_en: Sweet mandarin, flowers and warm spice.

g04.tagline_en: A large jar of soothing balm.
g04.benefit_zh: 全家都能用的舒缓保湿膏，皮肤干燥、不舒服时随时涂。
g04.benefit_en: A soothing balm for the whole family, for dry or uncomfortable skin any time.
g04.scene_zh: 每天 4–6 次少量涂抹需要护理的肌肤。
g04.scene_en: A little, 4–6 times a day, on skin that needs it.
g04.action_zh: 乳香、永久花、薰衣草、罗马洋甘菊温和舒缓，广藿香和麦卢卡滋润。
g04.action_en: Frankincense, helichrysum, lavender and Roman chamomile soothe; patchouli and manuka nourish.

g05.tagline_en: A small jar of soothing balm.
g05.benefit_zh: 放在包里的小罐保湿膏，外出时皮肤干燥也能随手照顾。
g05.benefit_en: A small balm for your bag, so dry skin can be cared for while you're out.
g05.scene_zh: 每天少量多次涂抹需要护理的肌肤。
g05.scene_en: A little, often, on skin that needs it.
g05.action_zh: 乳香、薰衣草温和，广藿香、古巴香脂滋润，茶树和天竺葵平衡。
g05.action_en: Frankincense and lavender soothe, patchouli and copaiba nourish, tea tree and geranium balance.

g07.benefit_zh: 胸口常觉得闷、心里不踏实，用这瓶温暖花香配方涂心前区。
g07.benefit_en: When your chest feels heavy and your heart unsettled, apply this warm floral blend over the heart.
g07.scene_zh: 每日少量多次涂抹心前区。
g07.scene_en: A little, often, over the heart each day.
g07.action_zh: 香蜂草、古巴香脂、乳香温和稳定，马郁兰和依兰放松。
g07.action_en: Melissa, copaiba and frankincense steady; marjoram and ylang ylang relax.

g08.tagline_en: Warm care for throat and chest.
g08.benefit_zh: 随身带着的小瓶，喉颈和胸口需要照顾时随时涂。
g08.benefit_en: A small bottle to carry, for whenever throat and chest need care.
g08.scene_zh: 每日多次涂抹喉颈、前胸和心前区。
g08.scene_en: Several times a day on throat, chest and over the heart.
g08.action_zh: 香蜂草、古巴香脂、乳香温和，没药和完美修复滋养。
g08.action_en: Melissa, copaiba and frankincense soothe; myrrh and DDR Prime nourish.

g10.title_en: A Spritz on the Way Out
g10.benefit_zh: 想让手、桌面、空气都清爽，做一瓶保卫喷雾随身带。
g10.benefit_en: For fresh hands, surfaces and air, make an On Guard spray to carry.
g10.action_zh: 保卫复方带温暖辛香和清洁感。
g10.action_en: On Guard has warm spice and a cleansing feel.
